english:
The Natchez lived among the bluffs above the lower Mississippi, where their ancestors built great earthen mounds. Emerald Mound served as a ceremonial centre before power shifted to the Grand Village of the Natchez. Their chief, known as the Great Sun, belonged to a ruling lineage in which descent passed through women; his successor was the son of a female member of the family.

French settlement brought mounting conflict over land. In 1729 the Natchez attacked Fort Rosalie and its settlers; French retaliation and further fighting devastated their towns. After their defeat in 1731, many captives were sent to Saint-Domingue and sold into slavery. Other Natchez escaped and found refuge among the Chickasaw, Muscogee and Cherokee, carrying their community's identity into new homelands.
simp_chinese:
纳奇兹人生活在密西西比河下游的高岸地带，祖先曾在这里建造巨大的土丘。翡翠土丘一度是仪式中心，后来权力转移到纳奇兹大村。最高首领称为“大太阳”，属于经母系传承的统治家族；继任者是家族女性成员的儿子。

法国人的定居使土地冲突不断加剧。1729年，纳奇兹人袭击罗萨利堡和殖民者；法国报复及随后的战斗毁坏了他们的城镇。1731年失败后，许多俘虏被运往圣多明格，卖为奴隶。另一些纳奇兹人逃脱，在奇克索、马斯科吉和切罗基人中寻求庇护，将社群身份带入新的家园。

english: Natigostec is a Mi'kmaq name for the long island at the mouth of the St. Lawrence, also known to the Innu as Notiskuan. Its shores and surrounding waters were visited by Indigenous hunters and fishers. In 1680 the French granted the island to Louis Jolliet, who established outposts there and on the Mingan coast. During war with England, William Phips's fleet seized his vessel and goods in 1690; two English ships burned his establishments two years later.
simp_chinese: 纳蒂戈斯特克是圣劳伦斯河口一座长岛的米克马克语名称，因努人则称其为诺蒂斯宽。原住民猎人和渔民曾到访岛岸及周围水域。1680年，法国将岛屿授予路易·若利埃，他在岛上和明根海岸设立据点。英法战争期间，威廉·菲普斯的舰队于1690年夺取了他的船只和货物；两年后，两艘英国船焚毁了他的据点。

english: Natinixwe, the People of the Place Where the Trails Return, are the Hupa inhabitants of Hoopa Valley on the Trinity River. Their lands extended from the South Fork of the Trinity to its meeting with the Klamath. The Hupa spoke an Athabaskan language and built houses of cedar planks, traveled in dugout canoes and made basket hats. Acorn bread and ceremonial sweathouses were among the customs they shared with neighboring peoples. To the south lived the Tsnungwe, close relatives in language and custom.
simp_chinese: 纳蒂尼克斯韦意为“道路汇归之地的人”，是三一河胡帕谷地居民的自称。胡帕人的土地从三一河南支延伸到三一河与克拉马斯河的汇合处。他们使用阿萨巴斯卡语，以雪松板建造房屋，乘独木舟出行，也编制篮帽。橡实面包和举行仪式的汗屋，是他们与邻人共有的习俗。南面的特斯农圭人与胡帕人在语言和习俗上关系密切。

english: Natori lies on the Sendai plain, where the Natori and Abukuma rivers approach the Pacific. Iwanuma grew as a post town on the Ōshū Kaidō and as a settlement before Takekoma Shrine. In 1660 a branch domain was established there for Tamura Muneyoshi, with lands divided from Sendai. Travellers, shrine worshippers and goods moving along the rivers all contributed to the town's life.
simp_chinese: 名取位于仙台平原，名取川与阿武隈川在此接近太平洋。岩沼作为奥州街道的宿场及竹驹神社门前町发展起来。1660年，仙台藩分出领地，为田村宗良设立岩沼支藩。道路上的旅人、参拜神社的信众和河上往来的货物，共同塑造了町镇生活。

english:
Natsitok, the Inuit name for Sandwich Bay on the Labrador coast, means the place of the ringed seals. The bay and its rivers were used by Inuit families who hunted, fished and travelled along this shore. Its sheltered waters lie between the open Labrador Sea and an interior of wooded rivers and hunting grounds.

In the later eighteenth century the British trader George Cartwright established fishing and trading stations around Sandwich Bay, dealing with Inuit and Innu as well as sending trappers inland. Inuit from farther north also travelled south to trade here. European men who came to work at the coastal stations formed families with Inuit women, adding new ties to the relationships already maintained along the Labrador coast.
simp_chinese:
纳齐托克是拉布拉多海岸桑威奇湾的因纽特语名，意为“环斑海豹之地”。因纽特家庭利用海湾与河流，在这一带狩猎、捕鱼和沿岸旅行。受遮蔽的湾水位于开阔的拉布拉多海与内陆森林河流、猎场之间。

十八世纪后期，英国商人乔治·卡特赖特在桑威奇湾周围设立捕鱼和贸易站，与因纽特人、因努人交易，也派捕兽者进入内陆。更北方的因纽特人同样南下来此交换货物。来商站工作的欧洲男子与因纽特女性组成家庭，为沿岸原有的社会联系增添了新的纽带。

english: Natuak is a long, quiet widening of the Rivière aux Mélèzes in the northern interior. The river is interrupted by many rapids elsewhere, but here its waters spread into a narrow lake. Naskapi speakers call it Natwakami, the great lake beside the river; Inuit know it as the little lake of the great river. Downstream the Mélèzes joins the Caniapiscau to form the Koksoak, which reaches Ungava Bay.
simp_chinese: 纳图阿克是梅莱兹河在北方内陆一处狭长而平静的宽阔河段。河流其他地方有许多急流，在这里水面却展开成湖。纳斯卡皮人称之为纳特瓦卡米，意为河边的大湖；因纽特人则称它为大河的小湖。梅莱兹河向下游与卡尼亚皮斯考河汇合，形成科克索阿克河，最终注入昂加瓦湾。

english: The Natuna Islands rise from the southern South China Sea between the Malay Peninsula and Borneo. Bunguran, also known as Great Natuna, is the largest island, surrounded by smaller islands and reefs. The group stretches north and south across open water, with the Subi Islands and Serasan among its southern neighbours.
simp_chinese: 纳土纳群岛从马来半岛与婆罗洲之间的南海水域升起。大纳土纳岛又称邦古兰，是群岛中最大的岛屿，周围分布着小岛与礁石。岛群在开阔海面上向南北延伸，南部邻岛包括苏比群岛和塞拉桑岛。

english: The Natuna Islands rise from the South China Sea between Borneo and the Malay Peninsula. Great Natuna, also called Bunguran, is the largest island, with forested hills above a coast of bays and smaller islands. Natuna belonged to the group known as the Seven Islands, linked historically with the Malay sultanates of Johor and Riau-Lingga. The islands' position placed their inhabitants among the sea routes joining the lands on either side of these waters.
simp_chinese: 纳土纳群岛耸立在婆罗洲与马来半岛之间的南海上。大纳土纳岛又称邦古兰，是群岛中最大的岛屿，森林覆盖的丘陵俯瞰海湾和附近小岛。纳土纳属于历史上称为“七岛”的群岛，与柔佛及廖内—林加马来苏丹国有联系。岛屿的位置使居民处于连接这片海域两侧土地的海上航路之间。

english:
Nauhtlan, later known as Nautla, was a settlement on the Gulf coast in Totonac country. Its Nahuatl name means “four places”. At the time of the Spanish arrival a Mexica garrison held the town, making it a point of tension between the imperial authorities and neighbouring Totonac communities.

In 1519 Juan de Escalante led Spaniards and Totonac allies against the forces of the local commander Cuauhpopoca at Nauhtlan. The attackers suffered heavy losses, and Escalante died of his wounds. News of the fighting and the casualties soon reached Hernán Cortés in the distant Mexican capital, where he used it in his confrontation with Moctezuma. The battle linked events on the Gulf coast directly to the wider struggle for power over Tenochtitlan.
simp_chinese:
纳瓦特兰后来称为瑙特拉，是托托纳克地区墨西哥湾沿岸的一处聚落。其纳瓦特尔语名称意为“四个地方”。西班牙人到来时，墨西加守军驻扎于此，使它成为帝国当局与邻近托托纳克社群之间的紧张地点。

1519年，胡安·德·埃斯卡兰特率西班牙人及托托纳克盟友在纳瓦特兰进攻当地指挥官夸乌波波卡的部队。进攻者损失惨重，埃斯卡兰特因伤去世。战事消息传到身处墨西哥都城的埃尔南·科尔特斯那里，他在与蒙特祖马的对抗中利用了这一事件。瑙特拉之战使墨西哥湾岸局势与争夺特诺奇蒂特兰的斗争直接联系起来。

english: The coast of Nautla lies where a river descends from the highlands of Veracruz to the Gulf of Mexico. Estuaries, mangroves and sandy shores meet at the river mouth, with the open sea to the east. Indigenous communities inhabited the region before the Spanish conquest. In the sixteenth century land around Nautla was granted to Juan de Cuenca, whose residence formed part of the settlement’s early colonial history.
simp_chinese: 瑙特兰海岸位于河流从韦拉克鲁斯高地流入墨西哥湾之处。河口有河口水域、红树林和沙岸交汇，东面是开阔大海。西班牙征服之前，原住民社群已居住于此。十六世纪，瑙特兰周围土地被授予胡安·德·昆卡，他的住所成为聚落早期殖民历史的一部分。

english:
Naumburg grew at the meeting of the Via Regia and the road to Regensburg. Its name recalls the new castle of the Ekkeharding margraves of Meissen, recorded in 1012. In 1028 the bishopric was moved here from Zeitz. A cathedral and school followed, while the town's fairs, recorded from 1278, made it an important regional centre of trade.

Leipzig's rising fairs and the Thirty Years' War weakened Naumburg's commerce. The Reformation ended the Catholic bishopric, and in 1561 an assembly at Naumburg affirmed the Augsburg Confession. From 1657 the district belonged to the Saxon branch of Saxe-Zeitz, whose rulers initially used the town castle as a residence. It returned to the main Saxon line in 1718 and passed to Prussia after the Congress of Vienna in 1815.
simp_chinese:
瑙姆堡兴起于王道与雷根斯堡道路的交会处。其名称令人想起迈森埃克哈德家族边境伯于1012年见诸记载的「新城堡」。1028年，主教区从蔡茨迁至此地，随后建立主教座堂和学校。自1278年有记载的瑙姆堡集市使城市成为重要贸易中心。

莱比锡集市的兴起和三十年战争削弱了瑙姆堡的商业。宗教改革结束了天主教主教区，1561年在此召开的会议确认《奥格斯堡信条》。1657年起，该地区属于萨克森家族的萨克森—蔡茨支系，其统治者最初以城堡为驻地。1718年，它回归萨克森主支；1815年维也纳会议后又转归普鲁士。

english:
Naumkeag was an Indigenous settlement on the peninsula that became Salem, on the Massachusetts coast. The Naumkeag people held territory between the Merrimack and Mystic rivers. War and epidemics in the early seventeenth century greatly reduced their population, including the loss of their powerful sachem Nanepashemet, before English settlers first arrived in the area.

In 1626 Roger Conant led a group of English fishermen from Cape Ann to settle at Naumkeag. The settlement was renamed Salem and grew into a trading port. In 1692 accusations of witchcraft led to trials in which nineteen people were hanged and Giles Corey was pressed to death after refusing to plead. Salem later prospered through maritime commerce, with ships carrying goods across the Atlantic and beyond.
simp_chinese:
瑙姆基格是马萨诸塞海岸上的原住民聚落，所在半岛后来成为塞勒姆。瑙姆基格人的领地位于梅里马克河与米斯蒂克河之间。十七世纪初，战争和疫病使人口大减；在英国移民抵达之前，他们的首领纳内帕谢梅特也已丧命。

1626年，罗杰·科南特率领一批英国渔民从安角来到瑙姆基格定居。聚落改名塞勒姆，逐渐发展为贸易港口。1692年，巫术指控引发审判，十九人被绞死，贾尔斯·科里拒绝答辩后被重石压死。此后塞勒姆的海上商业繁荣起来，船只跨越大西洋，甚至远航更远的地方运送货物。

english: Naungyo is remembered as the site of a battle in the Irrawaddy delta during the wars between Toungoo and Hanthawaddy. In 1538 the Toungoo commander Bayinnaung pursued a larger Hanthawaddy force to a river crossing. His troops crossed and attacked, winning a victory that strengthened the position of King Tabinshwehti. The delta's rivers and marshes shaped the movements of both armies. The region around Einme has been proposed as the setting of the battle.
simp_chinese: 瑙约因东吁与汉达瓦底战争期间的一场战役而为人所知。1538年，东吁将领勃印曩追击人数更多的汉达瓦底军队，来到一处渡河地点。他的部队渡河进攻并取得胜利，巩固了德彬瑞梯王的地位。三角洲的河流与沼泽影响了双方军队的行动；因梅周围地区被认为可能是战场所在。

english: Naupa Huen lies near the Limay River in the dry country of northern Patagonia. Its name is explained as “between ravines,” a reference to the cut and broken terrain around the river valley. The Limay flows east from the Andean lake country to meet the Neuquén, and its course offers a striking ribbon of water through the surrounding steppe.
simp_chinese: 瑙帕韦恩位于北巴塔哥尼亚干燥地带，靠近利迈河。其名称被解释为“峡谷之间”，指河谷周围被切割的崎岖地形。利迈河从安第斯湖区向东流，与内乌肯河汇合；河流如一条醒目的水带穿过周围的草原。

english: Ñaupahuasi stands on a hill above Yauyos in the western Andes of Peru. Its stone buildings command the valleys of the Cañete River and a neighboring ravine. A paved semicircular plaza, circular defensive structures, houses and storehouses show a settlement with several distinct functions. Some architectural details, including trapezoidal niches, reflect Inca influence. An early colonial church was built among the older remains, marking a change in the sacred and political life of the highland community.
simp_chinese: 瑙帕瓦西坐落在秘鲁安第斯西部、亚乌约斯上方的山丘上。石砌建筑俯瞰卡涅特河谷及邻近峡谷。铺石半圆形广场、圆形防御建筑、住宅和仓库显示这座聚落具有多种功能。梯形壁龛等建筑细节反映了印加影响。殖民时期早期，一座教堂建在较早遗存之间，标志着高地社区神圣与政治生活的变化。

english: The Naures were an Indigenous group of the Traslasierra valley, west of the main Córdoba mountain range. They are included among the peoples called Comechingones, whose communities inhabited both sides of the hills. Before Spanish conquest, the inhabitants cultivated crops and made pottery in the valleys. Streams descending from the mountains supplied a region where water and cultivable land were concentrated in narrow valleys amid drier country.
simp_chinese: 瑙雷人是科尔多瓦主山脉以西特拉斯拉谢拉山谷的原住民群体，属于被称作科梅钦贡人的诸民族。西班牙征服之前，山谷居民已经种植作物并制作陶器。山间流下的溪水供应这一地区；在周围较干燥的土地之间，水源与可耕地集中于狭长山谷。

english:
Naurskaya is a Cossack stanitsa on the left bank of the Terek, on the line of settlements defending Russia's approach to the Caucasus. Volga Cossack families were brought to the Terek in the late 1760s and settled in several stanitsas, among them Naurskaya. Its earth rampart and guns were soon tested in the Russo-Turkish War of 1768–1774.

In June 1774 a force led by the Crimean prince Shahbaz Giray approached Mozdok and turned against Naurskaya. Many of its Cossack men were away, and the defence fell to the remaining garrison and inhabitants. Women joined the fighting on the ramparts alongside the defenders. The assault failed after a day of fighting, and its repulse became a celebrated episode in the history of the Terek Cossacks.
simp_chinese:
瑙尔斯卡亚是捷列克河左岸的一座哥萨克村，属于防卫俄国通往高加索道路的聚落防线。十八世纪六十年代末，伏尔加哥萨克家庭被迁至捷列克河，在瑙尔斯卡亚等村庄定居。村庄的土垒与火炮很快便在1768—1774年俄土战争中受到考验。

1774年6月，克里米亚王族沙赫巴兹·格来率军逼近莫兹多克，随后转而进攻瑙尔斯卡亚。当时许多哥萨克男子不在村中，留守驻军和居民承担起防御任务；妇女也登上土垒，与守军并肩作战。进攻最终失败，这场防御战成为捷列克哥萨克历史上广为传颂的事件。

english: Nauru is an isolated coral island just south of the equator. A narrow coastal belt surrounds its higher interior, and a fringing reef borders the shore. Nauruans lived on the island long before European ships entered these waters, fishing and cultivating food on their small island. In 1798 Captain John Fearn sighted Nauru from the Hunter and named it Pleasant Island; islanders paddled out through the surf with fruit and coconuts.
simp_chinese: 瑙鲁是赤道以南的一座孤立珊瑚岛。狭窄海岸地带环绕着较高的内陆，岸外有珊瑚礁。欧洲船只进入这些水域之前，瑙鲁人已在岛上生活，以捕鱼和种植获取食物。1798年，约翰·费恩船长从猎人号上望见瑙鲁，将它称为宜人岛；岛民划船穿过浪涌，送来水果和椰子。

english: Nauru rises from the Pacific just south of the equator, its reef surrounding a small island rather than an open atoll lagoon. Nauruans raised juvenile ibija fish in the inland Buada Lagoon and gathered coconuts and pandanus. In 1798 canoes came out to meet John Fearn's Hunter; neither the islanders nor the ship's crew boarded the other's craft.
simp_chinese: 瑙鲁从赤道以南的太平洋中升起，环礁围住的是一座小岛，而非开阔的环礁潟湖。瑙鲁人在内陆的布阿达泻湖饲养伊比贾幼鱼，也采集椰子和露兜果。1798年，独木舟驶出迎接约翰·费恩的“猎人”号；岛民与船员都没有登上对方的船。

english: Northeast of Nauru, open equatorial Pacific waters surround the isolated coral island. In November 1798 John Fearn sighted Nauru while sailing the Hunter from New Zealand towards China. Islanders came out through the surf in canoes; the captain called their home Pleasant Island, though his crew did not go ashore.
simp_chinese: 瑙鲁东北方是开阔的赤道太平洋水域，环绕着这座孤立的珊瑚岛。1798年11月，约翰·费恩乘猎人号从新西兰驶往中国途中望见瑙鲁。岛民划独木舟穿浪迎来；船长将他们的家园称为宜人岛，但船员没有登岸。

english: Northwest of Nauru lies an open stretch of equatorial sea. The small coral island was inhabited long before it appeared on European charts. In 1798 John Fearn sailed past in the Hunter and named it Pleasant Island; Nauruans approached his ship in canoes, bringing coconuts and fruit.
simp_chinese: 瑙鲁西北方是一片开阔的赤道海面。这个小珊瑚岛出现在欧洲海图之前，岛上早已有人居住。1798年，约翰·费恩乘猎人号驶过，将其命名为宜人岛；瑙鲁人划着独木舟靠近船只，带来椰子和水果。

english: West of Nauru the Pacific stretches beyond the reef-fringed island. John Fearn passed through these seas in the Hunter in 1798 on a voyage from New Zealand towards China. He named Nauru Pleasant Island after seeing its shores and the people who paddled out to meet his vessel.
simp_chinese: 瑙鲁以西，太平洋延伸在礁岸之外。1798年，约翰·费恩乘猎人号从新西兰驶往中国，经过这片海域。他望见瑙鲁的海岸以及划船来迎的岛民后，将岛屿称为宜人岛。

english: Southwest of Nauru, open water lies beyond the island’s coral reef. Nauruans lived on the island before the arrival of European vessels. In 1798 Captain John Fearn recorded the island from the Hunter and received fruit from people who came through the surf in their canoes, without landing himself.
simp_chinese: 瑙鲁西南方的开阔海面延伸到珊瑚礁之外。欧洲船只抵达之前，瑙鲁人已在岛上生活。1798年，约翰·费恩船长从猎人号上记录了此岛；他没有登岸，但收到了划独木舟穿浪前来的岛民赠送的水果。

english: Southeast of Nauru the open ocean separates the island from other Pacific lands. In 1798 John Fearn sighted Nauru from the Hunter and recorded its inhabited shores. Canoes brought islanders to the ship with gifts of fruit and coconuts, while Fearn remained offshore and named the island Pleasant Island.
simp_chinese: 瑙鲁东南方，开阔海洋将此岛与太平洋其他岛陆隔开。1798年，约翰·费恩从猎人号上望见瑙鲁，记录了岛上有人居住的海岸。岛民乘独木舟来到船边，赠送水果和椰子；费恩留在海上，并将此岛命名为宜人岛。

english:
Nauset lies on outer Cape Cod, where beaches, estuaries, ponds and woodland supported Indigenous communities. The Nauset cultivated maize and beans as well as drawing on fish and other coastal resources. Canoes and paths connected settlements with productive places and neighbouring peoples.

European encounters brought both trade and violence. In 1614 an English expedition kidnapped seven Nauset men for sale into slavery. English colonists landed in Nauset territory in 1620 before establishing Plymouth across Cape Cod Bay; afterwards they visited Nauset to trade and obtain food. As colonial settlement expanded, Nauset people faced growing pressure on their land and relationships with neighbours.
simp_chinese:
瑙塞特位于科德角外侧，海滩、河口、池塘和林地支持着原住民社群。瑙塞特人种植玉米和豆类，也利用鱼类及其他沿海资源。独木舟和路径将聚落同资源地及邻近人群联系起来。

欧洲人的到来带来贸易，也带来暴力。1614年，一支英国探险队绑架了七名瑙塞特男子，准备将他们卖为奴隶。1620年，英国殖民者在瑙塞特人的土地登陆，随后在科德角湾对岸建立普利茅斯；此后他们多次前来贸易和购买食物。随着殖民定居扩张，瑙塞特人的土地和与邻人的关系面临越来越大的压力。

english: Los Navalucillos lies among the wooded hills of La Jara, west of Toledo. Its name recalls an area of meadows and rock-cut graves, while its settlement was divided between the jurisdictions of Toledo and Talavera. The two communities shared a parish before their administrative union in 1835. Their chapel of Nuestra Señora de las Saleras served as a focus of local devotion, linking the scattered inhabitants of the surrounding mountain country.
simp_chinese: 洛斯纳瓦卢西略斯位于托莱多以西拉哈拉地区的林木丘陵间。地名令人想起草地与岩石凿成的墓穴，而聚落曾分属托莱多和塔拉韦拉两个辖区。两个社区在1835年行政合并之前已共用教区。当地的萨莱拉斯圣母小教堂是宗教敬奉的中心，将散居周围山区的居民联系在一起。

english: Navan stands at the meeting of the Boyne and Blackwater, where travellers could cross both rivers on the route through Meath. An Anglo-Norman market town developed here under the Nangle family, with an Augustinian abbey beside the confluence. In the later Middle Ages Navan lay on the exposed frontier of the English Pale. O'Neill and O'Donnell plundered the town in 1539, and the Irish parliament subsequently imposed a charge on ploughlands in Meath and Westmeath to pay for its walls. The abbey was dissolved in the same troubled period.
simp_chinese: 纳文坐落在博因河与布莱克沃特河交汇处，穿行米斯的旅人在此可以渡过两条河流。盎格鲁—诺曼市镇在南格尔家族治下发展，河流交汇处附近还有一座奥斯定会修院。中世纪后期，纳文位于英格兰统治区暴露的边缘。1539年，奥尼尔与奥唐奈洗劫城镇；此后爱尔兰议会对米斯和西米斯的耕地征费，以修建城墙。修院也在这一动荡时期被解散。

english: Navarino Island lies south of the Beagle Channel, among the southernmost forests in the world. Lenga and ñirre grow in its deciduous woodlands, while evergreen Magellanic coigüe favours wetter places; peatlands spread over poorly drained ground. Along the coast, Yagán families travelled by canoe and left shell middens at places where they camped and gathered food.
simp_chinese: 纳瓦里诺岛位于比格尔海峡以南，拥有世界最南端的一些森林。落叶林中生长着伦加和尼雷，常绿的麦哲伦南青冈偏好更潮湿的地方，排水不良处则分布泥炭地。雅甘家庭沿海乘舟往来，在扎营和采集食物的地点留下贝丘。

english: Navassa is a small, rocky island between Jamaica and Hispaniola, near the southern approach to the Windward Passage. In 1504, while Columbus was stranded in Jamaica, members of his expedition crossed towards Hispaniola by canoe to seek help and stopped at the island. Its steep shores and scarce fresh water made it an inhospitable landfall, despite its position along a passage between the larger islands.
simp_chinese: 纳瓦萨是牙买加与伊斯帕尼奥拉之间一座岩石小岛，靠近向风海峡南侧入口。1504年哥伦布滞留牙买加时，远征队成员乘独木舟前往伊斯帕尼奥拉求援，途中在岛上停靠。尽管岛屿位于两座大岛之间的航路上，陡峭海岸与匮乏的淡水仍使它难以供人停留。

english: Navatu Reef lies in eastern Fijian waters among the scattered islands and coral formations of the Lau region. The Lau islands rise from volcanic platforms, many capped or fringed by coral, and deep channels separate their clusters. For navigators moving between Fiji and Tonga, these reefs formed part of a seascape that demanded careful knowledge of passages and landfalls.
simp_chinese: 纳瓦图礁位于斐济东部水域，处在劳群岛一带散布的岛屿与珊瑚构造之间。劳群岛从火山台地升起，许多岛屿顶部覆盖珊瑚或周围有珊瑚礁，深水航道分隔各个岛群。对于往来斐济与汤加的航海者，这些礁石构成了需要熟悉航道和登陆处的海洋景观。

english: Nachvak Fiord reaches deep into the Torngat Mountains, between walls of rock rising high above its cold waters. Inuit hunters found bowhead whales in the fjord, and a village on its northern shore held a succession of sod houses from the late fifteenth century into the early eighteenth. The country was known to Moravian missionaries seeking contact with Inuit farther north, though attempts to explore beyond Nachvak in 1774 and 1775 were unsuccessful.
simp_chinese: 纳赫瓦克峡湾深深伸入托恩加特山脉，两岸岩壁高耸于寒冷的水面之上。因纽特猎人在峡湾捕猎弓头鲸，北岸一处村落自十五世纪末至十八世纪初陆续建有泥草房屋。摩拉维亚传教士希望接触更北方的因纽特人，也知道这片地区；他们在1774年和1775年两次尝试越过纳赫瓦克探查海岸，却都未能成功。

english: Navia de Suarna lies among the mountains of the Ancares, beside the river that gives it its name. Its castle originated in the eleventh century and later passed to the Osorio family and the counts of Altamira. Destroyed during the great Irmandiño revolt of the fifteenth century, it was subsequently restored for habitation. A medieval bridge crosses the Navia below: its present pointed arch dates from a rebuilding in the same century, replacing an earlier Romanesque crossing.
simp_chinese: 纳维亚德苏阿尔纳坐落在安卡雷斯群山之中，濒临赋予它名字的纳维亚河。城堡始建于十一世纪，后来落入奥索里奥家族及阿尔塔米拉伯爵之手。十五世纪的伊尔曼迪尼奥大起义摧毁了城堡，此后它又被修复为住宅。山下的中世纪桥梁横跨纳维亚河，现存的尖拱是同一世纪改建的成果，取代了更早的罗曼式桥梁。

english: Navidakh stood on the middle Oxus near an important crossing at Keshk Zukhra-i Tahir. The river provided water for settlements and cultivated land amid the surrounding desert, while crossings connected the roads on its opposite banks. Archaeological finds, including Samanid coins, attest to the settlement's connections with the wider cities of Transoxiana. Travellers, merchants and armies used the river crossings, making the fortified places along this reach important links between Khorasan and the lands east of the Oxus.
simp_chinese: 纳维达赫位于阿姆河中游，靠近凯什克祖赫拉·塔希尔的重要渡口。河流为周围沙漠中的聚落和耕地供水，渡口则将两岸道路连在一起。包括萨曼王朝钱币在内的考古发现，证明这里与河中更广阔城市网络有所联系。旅人、商人和军队利用渡口，使这一河段的设防地点成为呼罗珊与阿姆河以东诸地之间的重要联系。

english:
The Navesink were a Lenape people of the coast around Sandy Hook and the river that bears their name. They shared the turtle totem and the Unami language with neighbouring groups, including the Raritan. Their territory included the sandy peninsula and the highlands to its south, with settlements along the creeks and cliffs.

In 1609 Henry Hudson's ship encountered the Navesink; a member of its crew, John Colman, was killed during a clash. Dutch investors later bought land in the area, and in 1665 English settlers negotiated the Monmouth Patent with the Navesink. In 1668 Richard Hartshorne bought the peninsula and called it Portland Poynt. The settlement of Red Bank, founded on the river in 1736, took its name from the river's red banks.
simp_chinese:
纳维辛克人是桑迪胡克和同名河流周围海岸的莱纳佩族群。他们与拉里坦人等邻族一样，以龟为图腾，使用乌纳米语。他们的领地包括半岛及其南面的高地，居民沿溪流和崖岸生活。

1609年，亨利·哈德逊的船只遇见纳维辛克人，一名船员约翰·科尔曼在冲突中丧生。荷兰投资者后来购买当地土地，1665年英国移民又与纳维辛克人协商蒙茅斯土地特许。1668年理查德·哈茨霍恩购得半岛，称其为波特兰角。1736年建立的红岸镇，得名于河流的红色河岸。

english: Navolok lies on the right bank of the Onega, in a forested stretch of the river between Lake Lacha and the White Sea. The Onega's rapids interrupted navigation, but its valley nevertheless formed a long route through the Russian North. Villages occupied clearings by the water, with the river connecting them to the lake country upstream and the coast downstream. The name describes a projecting piece of land, a common feature of northern river and sea shores.
simp_chinese: 纳沃洛克位于奥涅加河右岸，地处拉恰湖与白海之间森林覆盖的河段。奥涅加河的急流妨碍航行，但河谷仍是一条贯穿俄罗斯北方的长途通道。村落散布在水边的开垦地上，河流将它们与上游的湖区及下游海岸连接起来。纳沃洛克意为伸出的陆地，是北方河岸和海岸常见的地形名称。

english:
Nakskov lies at the head of a fjord on the western coast of Lolland. Beginning as a fishing settlement in the twelfth century, it became a royal market town whose harbour served the fertile lands of western Lolland and the trade with northern German towns. Its earliest surviving trading privileges date from 1266, in the reign of Erik V.

The town prospered through the late Middle Ages and Renaissance. Its House of the Holy Spirit became a monastery in 1470, and a Latin school was probably founded around the same time. Lübeck's forces captured and burned Nakskov in 1510, yet by about 1650 it was counted among Denmark's largest market towns. A long Swedish siege and bombardment ended in occupation in 1659, followed by prolonged decline. A Jewish community took root here from 1674, and the harbour was repaired in 1798.
simp_chinese:
纳克斯考位于洛兰岛西岸的峡湾尽头。它始于十二世纪的渔村，后来成为享有王室特权的集镇；港口服务于西洛兰的肥沃腹地，也参与与北德意志城镇的贸易。现存最早的贸易特权颁于埃里克五世在位的1266年。

中世纪晚期和文艺复兴时期，城镇日益兴盛。圣灵院于1470年成为修道院，拉丁学校也可能在同一时期创立。1510年吕贝克军队攻占并焚毁纳克斯考，但到1650年前后，它仍跻身丹麦最大的集镇之列。1659年，瑞典军队经过长时间围攻和炮击后占领城镇，随后这里长期衰落。1674年起，犹太社群在此扎根；1798年，港口得到修复。

english:
Nawa belongs to the Hauran country south of Damascus, where volcanic ground, fertile fields, and routes between settlements support a long-established agricultural society. Grain production and animal keeping supply households and markets, while local crafts and exchange connect villages with larger urban centers. Seasonal rain determines much cultivation, and wells and stored water are important to life away from dependable streams.

Nawa was the birthplace of the thirteenth-century jurist and hadith scholar al-Nawawi, who later studied and taught in Damascus. His writings gave the town a connection to Islamic learning beyond the Hauran. Mamluk and later Ottoman authority shaped the wider region's administration and taxation, while roads linked its countryside with Damascus and other markets.
simp_chinese:
奈瓦属于大马士革以南的哈夫兰地区，田地和聚落之间的道路支持长期农业生活。粮食和牲畜供应家庭与市场，地方手工业和交换将村庄同较大城市联系起来。季节降雨影响耕作，水井和蓄水对远离稳定水源的居民十分重要。

奈瓦是十三世纪法学家、圣训学者纳瓦维的出生地，他后来在大马士革求学和讲授。他的著作使这座城镇与哈夫兰之外的伊斯兰学术世界相连。马穆鲁克及后来的奥斯曼统治影响了广大地区的行政与赋税，道路则将乡村与大马士革及其他市场连接起来。

english: Nawagarh lies in the Maikal hills near Amarkantak, where the Narmada rises. The river leaves its sacred source and descends over the Kapildhara falls. Amarkantak’s temples include buildings raised under the Kalachuri rulers Gangeyadeva and Karna in the eleventh century. Their stone shrines stand near the pool honoured as the Narmada’s birthplace.
simp_chinese: 纳瓦加尔位于迈卡尔丘陵，靠近纳尔默达河的发源地阿马尔坎塔克。河流离开圣源后，流过卡皮尔达拉瀑布。阿马尔坎塔克的寺庙中有十一世纪卡拉丘里君主甘盖耶提婆和迦尔纳时期建造的建筑；石庙靠近被尊为纳尔默达河诞生之处的水池。

english: Nawa lies in the dry highlands south of Ghazni, among the valleys and ridges of southeastern Afghanistan. Its country forms part of the transition from the central mountains toward the lower plains and routes of the Gomal basin. Small settlements occupy the valleys between bare hills, where seasonal streams and limited water support cultivation and grazing.
simp_chinese: 纳瓦位于加兹尼以南的干燥高地，坐落在阿富汗东南部的山谷与山脊之间。当地属于中部山地向戈马尔盆地较低平原与道路过渡的地带。小聚落分布于光秃丘陵之间的谷地，季节性溪流和有限水源支撑着耕作与放牧。

english: Nawan Kot is a small fort in the Cholistan desert, away from the old bed of the Hakra River. Built of mud brick, it has four corner towers, thick walls and a parapet pierced with loopholes. It is attributed to Sardar Fazil Khan Abbasi, a member of the ruling family associated with Bahawalpur. Across the wider desert, other forts stood along the vanished river and the routes through the sands, among them Derawar, Marotgarh and Bijnotgarh.
simp_chinese: 纳万科特是焦利斯坦沙漠中的一座小堡，远离哈克拉河的旧河床。堡垒以土坯建造，四角有塔，墙壁厚重，女墙上设有射孔。它相传由萨达尔·法齐尔汗·阿巴西建造，他属于与巴哈瓦尔布尔有关的统治家族。更广阔的沙漠中，其他堡垒沿消失的河流和穿越沙地的道路分布，其中包括德拉瓦、马罗特加尔和比杰诺特加尔。

english: Nawu country lies on the southern Eyre Peninsula, around Coffin Bay and the coast facing the Southern Ocean. Nawu was a distinct language with connections to neighbouring Wirangu and Barngarla. Sheltered bays, coastal dunes and inland scrub formed the lands of communities linked by kinship and exchange across the peninsula.
simp_chinese: 纳乌地区位于艾尔半岛南部科芬湾及面向南大洋的海岸一带。纳乌语是一种独立语言，与邻近的维兰古语和巴恩加拉语有关。庇护海湾、沿海沙丘与内陆灌丛构成当地社群的土地，半岛各社群通过亲属关系和交换相连。

english: Naxi stands at the meeting of the Yongning River and the Yangtze, upstream from Luzhou. The Yongning descends through the hills from the south, bringing a difficult but important route out of the mountain country to the great river. Its rapids were notorious: a Ming account of work on the waterway counted scores of dangerous stretches between the upper valley and the Yangtze.
simp_chinese: 纳溪位于永宁河与长江交汇处，在泸州上游。永宁河从南面的山地流来，是山区通往大江的一条重要水路，行船却十分艰难。明代有关整治河道的记载列出了众多险滩，显示出从上游山谷到长江的路途并不平坦。

english:
The largest of the Cyclades, Naxos was famed for its agriculture, livestock and emery, a hard stone prized as an abrasive. In antiquity its wealth made it a leading island of the Aegean. A failed Persian attack in 499 BC helped set the Ionian Revolt in motion, while Athens later crushed its attempt to leave the Delian League.

After the Fourth Crusade, Marco Sanudo conquered Naxos and made it the seat of the Duchy of the Archipelago. Latin feudal law was introduced, though Greek inhabitants continued to use Byzantine civil law. Anatolian raids repeatedly threatened the island: in 1341 Umur of Aydın carried away thousands of people and imposed tribute. In 1566 Sultan Selim II deposed the last Latin Christian duke and appointed Joseph Nasi; after Nasi's death in 1579, the Ottomans annexed the duchy.
simp_chinese:
纳克索斯是基克拉泽斯群岛中最大的岛屿，以农业、畜牧业和用作磨料的坚硬金刚砂闻名。古代的财富使它成为爱琴海的重要岛屿：公元前499年波斯人攻岛失败，成为伊奥尼亚起义的诱因之一；雅典后来又镇压了它退出提洛同盟的尝试。

第四次十字军东征后，马尔科·萨努多征服纳克索斯，将其作为群岛公国的统治中心。拉丁式封建法被引入岛上，希腊居民仍继续使用拜占庭民法。安纳托利亚势力反复袭扰该岛：1341年，艾登的乌穆尔掳走数千人并迫使岛民纳贡。1566年，苏丹塞利姆二世废黜最后一位拉丁基督徒公爵，改任约瑟夫·纳西；纳西于1579年去世后，奥斯曼吞并了公国。

english: The Naya River rises in Colombia’s Western Cordillera and runs through humid forest toward the Pacific. Its basin extends from the mountain crest to the coast, between the neighbouring Micay and Yurumanguí watersheds. Steep slopes, heavy rainfall and a network of streams shape the country. Indigenous and Afro-descendant communities have used the river and forest for fishing, cultivation and other livelihoods.
simp_chinese: 纳亚河发源于哥伦比亚西部山脉，穿过湿润森林流向太平洋。流域从山脊延伸至海岸，位于米凯河与尤鲁曼吉河流域之间。陡坡、丰沛降雨和众多溪流塑造了当地地貌。原住民和非洲裔社群利用河流与森林捕鱼、耕作并维持其他生计。

english:
Nayagarh lies among the hills west of the Odisha coastal plain. It was the seat of a small kingdom whose ruling family traced its origins to Suryamani, a Baghela pilgrim said to have come from Rewa. The family’s emblem was a tiger’s head, and its rulers patronized the worship of Vishnu and local deities.

According to the local account, Bagel Singh moved the capital to Nayagarh during his reign around the turn of the sixteenth century. Later Raghunath Singh took advantage of political upheaval in Odisha to expand against neighbouring chiefs, acquiring lands from Ranapur, Boudh and Ghumusar. Before his death he divided his estate among his sons; one received Nayagarh and another the lands that became Khandapara. In 1817 the ruler of Nayagarh supported the uprising against the East India Company centred on nearby Khurda.
simp_chinese:
讷耶格尔位于奥里萨沿海平原以西的丘陵间，曾是一个小王国的驻地。王室将其起源追溯至苏里亚马尼；传说这位巴盖拉朝圣者来自雷瓦。家族以虎头为标志，统治者赞助毗湿奴和地方神祇的崇拜。

地方记载称，十五世纪末至十六世纪初，巴盖尔·辛格将都城迁到讷耶格尔。后来，拉古纳特·辛格利用奥里萨的政治动荡向邻近首领扩张，从拉纳普尔、博德和古穆萨尔取得土地。临终前，他将地产分给儿子，一人获得讷耶格尔，另一人获得后来成为坎达帕拉的土地。1817年，讷耶格尔统治者支持以附近库尔达为中心的反东印度公司起义。

english: Nayarit is a mountainous country of steep barrancas and river valleys in the western Sierra Madre. It is the homeland of the Cora, who call themselves Náayeri, as well as neighbouring Indigenous peoples. The high sierra sheltered communities that maintained their independence long after Spanish forces occupied the surrounding lowlands. In 1722 a Spanish expedition seized the Mesa del Nayar, a political and religious centre of the Cora. Military conquest was followed by the establishment of Jesuit missions and new settlements, transforming the political organization of the region. Cora communities nevertheless continued to maintain their own traditions in the mountain country.
simp_chinese: 纳亚里特是西马德雷山脉中峡谷陡峭、河谷纵横的地区，是自称纳亚里人的科拉人及邻近原住民的故土。西班牙军队占领周围低地很久之后，高山中的社区仍保持独立。1722年，西班牙远征队夺取科拉人的政治与宗教中心纳亚尔台地。军事征服之后，耶稣会传教区与新聚落相继建立，改变了地区的政治组织。科拉社区仍在山区延续自己的传统。

english: The coast of Nayarit faces the Pacific between the mountains of western Mexico and the mouth of the Gulf of California. To the north lie the extensive lagoons, mangroves and marshes of the Marismas Nacionales, where fresh water mingles with the sea. Communities along this shore made use of its abundant marine resources; great deposits of shells bear witness to a long history of gathering and fishing.
simp_chinese: 纳亚里特海岸面朝太平洋，位于墨西哥西部群山与加利福尼亚湾口之间。北部是广阔的国家沼泽地，潟湖、红树林和沼泽连成一片，淡水与海水在此交汇。沿岸居民利用丰富的海洋资源，巨大的贝壳堆积见证了漫长的采集与捕鱼历史。

english: Nayband is an isolated oasis on the desert road between Tabas and Ravar. Houses climb a rocky slope in tiers, above small fields and date palms watered by springs. For travellers crossing the central deserts, it offered a welcome place to rest and replenish supplies. Medieval writers described an inn, houses and irrigated fields here, while the mountains sheltered the settlement from the vast barren country around it.
simp_chinese: 奈班德是塔巴斯与拉瓦尔之间沙漠道路上的孤立绿洲。房屋沿岩坡层叠而上，下方的小块田地和椰枣树由泉水灌溉。对于穿越伊朗中部沙漠的旅人，这里是难得的歇脚和补给之处。中世纪作家曾描述此地的旅舍、民居与灌溉田地，山岭则庇护着聚落，使其与周围广阔荒地相隔。

english: Nayband Bay lies on the northern shore of the Persian Gulf, where dry hills meet shallow coastal water. Mangroves grow in sheltered tidal areas, while reefs and sandy ground support fish and other marine life. Nearby Siraf was once a major port linking the Gulf to the Indian Ocean. Although its commercial peak came earlier, its harbour remained part of a coast threaded by maritime routes and small anchorages.
simp_chinese: 奈班德湾位于波斯湾北岸，干燥丘陵在此与沿海浅水相接。红树林生长于避风潮间地带，礁石与沙地养育鱼类和其他海洋生物。附近的锡拉夫曾是连接海湾与印度洋的重要港口；尽管其商业鼎盛时期更早，这座港湾仍处在海路和小锚地交织的海岸上。

english:
Nayoro was an Ainu settlement on the western coast of Sakhalin, near routes across the island to the fishing and hunting grounds of the east. Its position made it a meeting place in the trade between the Amur region, Sakhalin and Japan. Furs travelled through Indigenous networks, while silk and other goods moved in the opposite direction.

In the eighteenth century, two sons of a Nayoro elder were taken to the mainland after a conflict. One returned bearing a Manchu document appointing him a clan headman, a title later inherited by his son. Visitors from the lower Amur called at Nayoro on their way south, and its leaders dealt with both these traders and Japanese officials as control over the island's commerce became increasingly contested.
simp_chinese:
名寄是库页岛西岸的阿伊努聚落，靠近横越岛屿、通往东岸渔猎地区的路线。它的位置使这里成为黑龙江地区、库页岛与日本之间的贸易交会处。毛皮经过原住民网络流通，丝绸等货物则沿相反方向传递。

十八世纪，名寄一位长老的两个儿子在冲突后被带到大陆。其中一人返回时带着满文任命文书，获得族长职衔，后来由其子继承。来自黑龙江下游的商人南行时在名寄停留；随着岛上贸易的控制权日益受到争夺，当地首领既与这些商人交往，也与日本官员打交道。

english: Nazarovo lies on the left bank of the Chulym, a tributary of the Ob, in a basin west of Krasnoyarsk. The village was named for the peasant Nazariy Patyukov, who settled near the mouth of the Adadym. Its setting on the Chulym connected the settlement with the river country of southern Siberia, where cultivated land and woodland meet in the broad basin.
simp_chinese: 纳扎罗沃位于克拉斯诺亚尔斯克以西的盆地中，坐落在鄂毕河支流丘雷姆河的左岸。村庄得名于农民纳扎里·帕秋科夫，他曾在阿达德姆河口附近定居。丘雷姆河上的位置将聚落与西伯利亚南部的河流地区连接起来，广阔盆地内耕地和林地相接。

english: Nazhi was an old oasis settlement west of Hami. According to a Tang geographical work, its town was built by people from the ancient kingdom of Shanshan, and the local name for Shanshan gave Nazhi its name. The Tang established a county here in 630, abolished it in 718 and restored it nine years later. The site belonged to a chain of watered settlements along the eastern road into the Western Regions.
simp_chinese: 纳职是哈密以西的一处古老绿洲聚落。唐代地理书称，其城由古鄯善国人所筑，当地人对鄯善的称呼便成为纳职之名。唐朝于630年在此置县，718年废除，九年后又恢复。这里是西域东部道路沿线一系列有水聚落之一。

english: Nazilli lies on the fertile Büyük Menderes plain of western Anatolia, with mountains rising on either side of the river valley. Its district passed from the Menteşe rulers to the Aydınid principality founded around Birgi. The valley connected inland settlements with the Aegean, and its rich soils supported the villages around the town. Under the Ottomans Nazilli remained part of this productive river country.
simp_chinese: 纳济利位于安纳托利亚西部肥沃的大门德雷斯平原，河谷两侧山岭高耸。当地先后属于门泰谢统治者和以比尔吉为中心建立的艾登公国。河谷将内陆聚落与爱琴海相连，肥沃土壤供养城镇周围的村庄。奥斯曼时期，纳济利仍是这片富饶河流地区的一部分。

english: Nazimovo lies on the left bank of the Yenisei, north of Yeniseisk, in the forested country of the middle river. Local accounts trace it to a winter station founded in 1631 and associate its beginnings with the explorer Yerofey Khabarov. The Yenisei flows north through a broad region of taiga, receiving rivers from both the western lowland and the uplands to the east before reaching the Arctic.
simp_chinese: 纳济莫沃位于叶尼塞斯克以北的叶尼塞河左岸，坐落在大河中游的森林地带。地方记载将它追溯至1631年建立的冬营地，并把其起源与探险者叶罗费·哈巴罗夫联系起来。叶尼塞河向北流过广阔的泰加林，汇集西部低地和东部高地的河流，最终通向北冰洋。

english: Nazko lies on a river whose Dakelh name means “flowing from the south.” Its people travelled through the forests and rolling country west of the Fraser, moving between seasonal camps, fishing places and hunting grounds. The Nuxalk-Carrier Grease Trail crossed their territory, linking inland communities with the Pacific coast. Along it travelled people, news and goods, including the prized oil made from eulachon fish.
simp_chinese: 纳兹科位于同名河流沿岸，达凯尔语河名意为“从南方流来”。当地人在弗雷泽河以西的森林和起伏地带往来，随季节迁移于营地、渔场和猎场之间。努哈尔克—卡里尔油脂之路穿过他们的土地，连接内陆社群与太平洋海岸；行人、消息和货物沿路流动，其中包括珍贵的烛鱼油。

english: Nazok-e Olya lies in the northwestern country between Khoy and the Araxes, east of Maku. Here the settlements of the plateau stand among plains and mountain approaches leading toward the river and the neighbouring lands of the Caucasus. The wider district lay within the frontier zone contested by Ottoman and Iranian rulers, through which the roads from Khoy and Maku carried travellers across the region.
simp_chinese: 上纳佐克位于伊朗西北部霍伊与阿拉斯河之间、马库以东。高原上的聚落分布在平原和山地通道之间，道路通向河流与邻近的高加索地区。这片地区处于奥斯曼与伊朗统治者争夺的边疆地带，来自霍伊和马库的道路将旅人带往各方。

english:
Nazran developed in the country between the Sunzha and Nazranka rivers as Ingush families settled on the plains. In 1781 the Russian military surveyor Ludwig Steder recorded Ingush watch posts in this area. The year later became the town's conventional foundation date, although it dates a surviving description rather than proving that settlement began at that instant.

Relations with Russian authorities took a more formal shape in 1810. In August, representatives of six local lineages signed an act at Vladikavkaz accepting Russian subjecthood. A Russian redoubt was established at Nazran that autumn, adding a permanent military institution to the existing community. Settlement, negotiated allegiance and fortification thus shaped the place together. The move of Ingush households from mountain country to the plains was a wider process continuing through the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries; Nazran became one of its important centres at the meeting of local lineage communities and expanding Russian frontier authority.
simp_chinese:
纳兹兰在孙扎河与纳兹兰卡河之间发展，印古什家庭逐渐向平原定居。1781年，俄国军事测绘员路德维希·施特德尔记录了这一带的印古什警戒哨所。这个年份后来成为城镇约定的建城年代，但它标记的是现存记述，不能证明聚落恰在当时从无到有。

1810年，地方社群与俄国当局的关系进一步制度化。八月，六个地方世系的代表在弗拉季高加索签署接受俄国臣属关系的文书。同年秋，俄国在纳兹兰建立棱堡，为已有社群增加常驻军事机构。定居、效忠协商与设防由此共同塑造地方历史。印古什家庭从山地迁向平原，是贯穿十八至十九世纪的较大过程，纳兹兰则成为地方世系社群与扩张中俄国边疆权威交汇的一处重要中心。

english: The Nazym rises among the Siberian Uvals and winds through the forest and wetlands north of the Ob. The Nyukhsatyugan joins its right bank in the middle reaches. Farther downstream, the Nazym runs southeast roughly parallel to the Ob before turning south to meet it.
simp_chinese: 纳济姆河发源于西伯利亚丘陵，蜿蜒流过鄂毕河以北的森林与湿地。纽赫萨特尤甘河在中游从右岸汇入。纳济姆河继续向东南流，与鄂毕河大致平行，最后转向南方汇入鄂毕河。

english: Nbengo lies inland from N'zeto, north of the Loge River and the Atlantic coast. To the north stood Soyo, a province of the kingdom of Kongo, while the Loge marked the southern country shown on maps of the kingdom. The nearby M'Bridge and Loge rivers flow west towards the ocean, cutting through the coastal hinterland.
simp_chinese: 恩本戈位于恩泽托的内陆，在洛热河和大西洋海岸以北。北面是刚果王国的索约省；王国地图上的南部地区则可见洛热河。附近的姆布里奇河和洛热河穿过沿海腹地，向西流入大海。

english: The Rocky Mountains rise between the upper Columbia and the plains to the east. Ktunaxa travelers used the route later called Howse Pass to reach bison country beyond the mountains. In 1807 David Thompson crossed the same pass with a North West Company party and established Kootenae House near the upper Columbia, a trading post intended to exchange goods with the Ktunaxa.
simp_chinese: 落基山脉耸立在哥伦比亚河上游与东部平原之间。库特纳哈人利用后来称为豪斯山口的通道，前往山外的野牛产地。1807年，大卫·汤普森率西北公司的队伍穿过同一山口，在哥伦比亚河上游附近建立库特奈贸易站，与库特纳哈人交换货物。

english: Ncando lies near the Louessé River and Makabana, between the forested Chaillu massif and the Niari depression. The Louessé receives the Mpounkou before joining the Niari. The Niari crosses the long plain between the Chaillu and Mayombe mountains, then turns toward the Atlantic as the Kouilou.
simp_chinese: 恩坎多靠近卢埃塞河与马卡巴纳，位于森林覆盖的沙伊山地和尼亚里洼地之间。卢埃塞河接纳姆蓬库河后汇入尼亚里河。尼亚里河穿过沙伊与马永贝山地之间的长形平原，再以奎卢河之名转向大西洋。

sources.title: congo - programme d appui au secteur des transports phase 2 et aux infrastructures agricoles et rurales connexes - resume eies - 03 2016.pdf

english: The Nkomi lived around the Fernan Vaz lagoon and the Rembo Nkomi, linked by waterways and paths to the forested interior. Their traditions remember an earlier period under a supreme chief, Ré-Ngondo, followed by a time when families lived under separate leaders. Some clans moved up the Rembo, while others travelled towards the lower Ogooué. Trade routes extended inland towards the Ngounié country.
simp_chinese: 恩科米人居住在费尔南瓦兹潟湖和伦博恩科米河一带，水道与小径将他们与森林内陆相连。传统记得他们曾处于一位最高首领雷恩贡多的统治之下，后来各家庭又在不同首领领导下生活。一些氏族沿伦博河向上游迁移，另一些则前往奥果韦河下游；贸易路线也向内陆延伸至恩古涅地区。

english: The badlands of the Little Missouri form a rugged belt of eroded hills and valleys in the northern Plains. The river has cut into the sedimentary layers of the Missouri Plateau, exposing bands of rock in steep slopes, buttes and gullies. This broken country follows the Little Missouri northward toward its meeting with the Missouri, standing in sharp relief against the more level prairie around it.
simp_chinese: 小密苏里河恶地是北部平原上一片由侵蚀形成的崎岖丘谷。河流切入密苏里高原的沉积层，在陡坡、孤丘和沟壑中露出层层岩石。这片破碎的地貌沿小密苏里河向北延伸，直至它与密苏里河汇合，与周围较为平坦的草原形成鲜明对照。

english: N'dalatando stands in the agricultural country of Cazengo, north of the Lucala River in the hills of Angola's interior. The place takes its name from the chiefdom of Ndala Ntandu. Portuguese military intervention reached the chiefdom in the seventeenth century, after which a resident chief was appointed to maintain contact with the region's sobas, or local rulers. In the 1830s Portuguese traders and farmers began arriving in the area from Dondo and crossing the Lucala to settle in Cazengo.
simp_chinese: 恩达拉坦多位于安哥拉内陆丘陵的卡曾戈农业地区，处在卢卡拉河以北。这里得名于恩达拉·恩坦杜酋邦。十七世纪，葡萄牙的军事行动抵达该酋邦，随后任命了一名驻地首领，负责与该地区的索巴，即地方统治者，保持联系。十九世纪三十年代，葡萄牙商人和农民开始从东多来到这一带，渡过卢卡拉河，在卡曾戈定居。

english: Ndar is an island near the mouth of the Senegal River, in the country of the kingdom of Waalo. In 1659 a French trading company established a fortified post there, calling it Saint-Louis after the French king. Its position linked the Atlantic with the river trade of the interior. The settlement grew through relations with African rulers and merchants, while European powers contested the post; the English occupied it on several occasions before 1817.
simp_chinese: 恩达尔是塞内加尔河口附近的一座岛屿，位于瓦洛王国境内。1659年，法国贸易公司在此建立设防商站，以法国国王之名称其为圣路易。这里的位置将大西洋与内陆河上贸易连接起来。聚落通过与非洲统治者和商人的关系发展，欧洲列强也争夺这一据点；1817年以前，英国人曾数次占领此地。

english: Ndáwe qóhä, the Fire or Camp Circle people, were a Lipan Apache band whose territory included the country from the San Saba to the upper Nueces River. They moved through the hills and river valleys of central and western Texas, where bison provided an important resource. The Lipan consisted of numerous bands, related by language and custom, which joined together for particular purposes and dispersed again into smaller communities.
simp_chinese: 恩达韦科哈即火圈或营圈人，是利潘阿帕奇人的一个群体，活动地区从圣萨巴河延伸到努埃塞斯河上游。他们在得克萨斯中西部的丘陵和河谷间迁徙，野牛是重要资源。利潘人由许多语言和习俗相近的群体组成；各群体为了特定目的联合，随后又分散为较小的社群。

english: Nde-nda-i is a name associated with the Nednhi, a southern group of Chiricahua Apache. Their country extended across the rugged mountains and desert borderlands of southeastern Arizona, northern Sonora and northwestern Chihuahua. Apache communities moved through a broad landscape, maintaining relations with neighbouring peoples through kinship, alliance, trade and conflict. Mountain ranges offered places of refuge and access to resources across the dry lowlands.
simp_chinese: 恩德纳迪是与内德尼人相关的名称；内德尼人是奇里卡瓦阿帕奇人的南方支系。其地域遍及亚利桑那东南部、索诺拉北部和奇瓦瓦西北部的崎岖山地与沙漠边缘。阿帕奇社区在广阔土地上移动，通过亲属关系、结盟、贸易与冲突同邻族往来。山地提供庇护之所，也通向干旱低地各处的资源。

english: N’Délé lies in the wooded country south of the Bahr Aouk, on the frontier between the Chad basin and the lands of the Banda. In the early nineteenth century this broader frontier was known as Dar al-Kuti. Around 1830 Djougoultoum, a prince who had fled a succession struggle in Baguirmi, established a seat at Chá on the Diangara and governed a tributary territory linked to Wadai through Dar Runga.
simp_chinese: 恩代莱位于巴尔奥克河以南的林地，处在乍得盆地与班达人土地之间的边缘地区。19世纪初，这片更广阔的边境地带被称为达尔库蒂。约1830年，因巴吉尔米王位争夺而出逃的王子朱古尔图姆在迪安加拉河畔的查建立统治中心，管理一块通过达尔龙加向瓦达伊纳贡的领地。

english: Ndembo lies in the wooded hills northeast of Luanda, among the small chiefdoms known collectively as the Dembos. Their rulers, often bearing the title ndembo, governed Kimbundu-speaking communities and could be joined in loose alliances. These chiefdoms acknowledged the claims of larger powers such as Kongo, Matamba and Portuguese Angola, while retaining considerable autonomy. In the late seventeenth century Kahenda grew in influence among them as the power of neighbouring Mbwila declined.
simp_chinese: 恩登博位于罗安达东北方的林木丘陵，属于统称为登博斯的众多小酋邦。其统治者常以恩登博为称号，治理操金本杜语的社区，有时组成松散联盟。这些酋邦承认刚果、马坦巴和葡属安哥拉等较大势力的权威要求，同时保持相当程度的自主。十七世纪末，邻近的姆布维拉势力衰落，卡亨达在诸酋邦中的影响逐渐增长。

english:
Ndiaganiao lies in the Serer country of western Senegal, in the historic region of Baol. Farming settlements occupy the inland plains between the Petite Côte and the neighbouring Wolof kingdoms. Local accounts recall raids by the armed retainers of Cayor and Baol, whose rulers competed for power in the region. To the west, the coastal port of Portudal connected Baol with Atlantic commerce from the early sixteenth century.

The later city of Thiès lies here.
simp_chinese:
恩迪亚加尼奥位于塞内加尔西部塞雷尔人地区，属于历史上的贝奥尔。农业聚落分布在小海岸与邻近沃洛夫王国之间的内陆平原。地方记述回忆了卡约尔和贝奥尔武装扈从的袭扰，其统治者曾在地区内争夺权力。西面的波图达尔港自十六世纪初起将贝奥尔与大西洋贸易联系起来。

后来的捷斯即位于此地。

english: Ndom is a Papuan language of Kolopom, the large low island off southern New Guinea. Its speakers live in the western part of the island, separated from the mainland by a strait. Ndom is related to Riantana and Kimaghama, other languages spoken on Kolopom.
simp_chinese: 恩多姆语是新几内亚南岸外大型低岛科洛波姆的一种巴布亚语言。使用者居住在岛屿西部，海峡将岛屿与大陆分隔开。恩多姆语与岛上的里安塔纳语和基马加马语有关。

english: Ndombe is the country of a coastal people south of Benguela, in the dry lands around Dombe Grande. The Luache River reaches the Atlantic here, cutting through a landscape of hills and sandy coast. Ndombe communities also lived farther north, where Benguela was established by the Portuguese in 1617. Along this coast, pastoralists kept livestock in a country where rainfall is uncertain and watercourses can run dry.
simp_chinese: 恩多姆贝是本格拉以南沿海族群的土地，位于多姆贝格兰德周围的干旱地区。卢阿切河穿过丘陵与沙质海岸，在此注入大西洋。更北方也有恩东贝人的社群，1617年葡萄牙人在那里建立了本格拉。沿海牧民在这片雨水不定、河道可能干涸的土地上饲养牲畜。

sources.title: john e. flint the cambridge history of africa vbook4you.pdf

english: Off southern Gabon, the Atlantic meets a low coast of beaches, lagoons and forest. Near Setté Cama, a narrow strip of land separates the Ndogo lagoon from the sea; farther south, Mayumba stands between the ocean and the Banio lagoon. Rivers cross the coastal plain to enter these sheltered waters. In the early Atlantic era, the coast south of Cape Sainte-Catherine lay within the wider sphere of the kingdom of Loango, whose influence extended northward from the Congo coast.
simp_chinese: 加蓬南部海岸低平，大西洋在此与海滩、潟湖和森林相接。塞特卡马附近，一条狭长陆地将恩多戈潟湖与大海分开；更南面的马永巴则坐落在海洋与巴尼奥潟湖之间。河流穿过沿海平原，注入这些较为平静的水域。大西洋贸易早期，圣凯瑟琳角以南的海岸处在洛安戈王国的广大影响范围内，王国势力从刚果海岸向北延伸。

english:
Ndorwa was a kingdom of the Great Lakes highlands, ruled by the Abashambo dynasty. Its lands extended across the country north and east of central Rwanda, where both cultivators and cattle keepers made their homes. In the eighteenth century the kingdom became the object of repeated Rwandan campaigns under Kigeli Ndabarasa. After the death of Ndorwa's ruler Gahaya, Ndabarasa overcame rival claimants and brought the kingdom under his control, claiming the inheritance of its rulers for himself.

The later city of Byumba lies here.
simp_chinese:
恩多尔瓦是大湖高地的一个王国，由阿巴尚博王朝统治。其土地横跨卢旺达中部以北和以东的地区，耕作者与牧牛者都在这里安家。十八世纪，卢旺达王基盖利·恩达巴拉萨多次进攻恩多尔瓦。当地统治者加哈亚去世后，恩达巴拉萨击败其他王位竞争者，将王国置于自己控制之下，并宣称继承了恩多尔瓦统治者的权位。

后来的比温巴即位于此地。

sources.title: Antecedents to Modern Rwanda by Vansina,  Jan(BookFi).pdf

english:
Ndrumbea, also called Drubea, is a Kanak language of southern New Caledonia, associated with the country around Dumbéa and Païta. The southern end of Grande Terre combines river valleys and mountain slopes with a broad lagoon behind the barrier reef. Its communities maintained their own clan lands and ties with neighbours across the region.

The later city of Nouméa lies here.
simp_chinese:
恩德伦贝亚语又称德鲁贝亚语，是新喀里多尼亚南部的卡纳克语言，与栋贝阿和派塔一带有关。大岛南端有河谷与山坡，堡礁后方则是一片宽阔潟湖。当地社群拥有各自的氏族土地，并与区域内的邻居保持联系。

后来的努美阿即位于此地。

english:
Nduga was one of the old principalities of central Rwanda, south of the Nyabarongo River. Its rulers governed through alliances among chiefs, each holding a relatively small domain. During the seventeenth century this older principality disappeared amid shifting loyalties and the rise of new powers. The Nyiginya ruler Ruganzu Ndori went on to expand his authority over several neighbouring kingdoms, helping to shape the central lands from which the kingdom of Rwanda grew.

The later city of Kigali lies here.
simp_chinese:
恩杜加是卢旺达中部的古老小国之一，位于尼亚巴龙戈河南岸。统治者依靠各首领之间的联盟行使权力，而每位首领掌管的领地相对有限。十七世纪，随着效忠关系变化和新势力崛起，旧恩杜加小国消失。尼金尼亚王鲁甘祖·恩多里随后将权威扩展至几个邻近王国，塑造了后来卢旺达王国成长的核心地区。

后来的基加利即位于此地。

sources.title: Antecedents to Modern Rwanda by Vansina,  Jan(BookFi).pdf

english: The forested southern slopes of New Guinea’s central ranges descend toward the great rivers and wetlands of the Asmat lowlands. Steep valleys carry streams from the high country into dense tropical forest. The Nduga region lies at the meeting of these mountains and the river country farther south.
simp_chinese: 新几内亚中央山脉森林覆盖的南坡向阿斯马特低地的大河与湿地下降。陡峭山谷中的溪流从高地流入茂密热带森林。恩杜加地区位于这些山脉与更南方河流地带的交界处。

english: The Ndwandwe were a major power in the country of the Mkuze and Phongolo rivers under their chief Zwide. Their rivalry with Dingiswayo's Mthethwa and the rising Zulu kingdom changed the fortunes of many communities in southeastern Africa. Dingiswayo was captured and killed in fighting with Zwide's people around 1817 or 1818. Shaka then brought many Mthethwa warriors into his own growing power. In 1819 and 1820 he defeated Ndwandwe armies, including at the Mhlatuze River. The defeats broke up Zwide's loose confederacy. Leaders such as Soshangane and Zwangendaba took followers northward, carrying the consequences of these wars far beyond their former home.
simp_chinese: 在首领兹维德统治下，恩德万德韦人成为姆库泽河与蓬戈洛河地区的重要力量。他们与丁吉斯瓦约的姆泰特瓦人以及正在崛起的祖鲁王国相互竞争，改变了非洲东南部许多社群的命运。约1817或1818年，丁吉斯瓦约在与兹维德的人交战时被俘杀害。随后，沙卡把许多姆泰特瓦战士纳入自己不断壮大的势力。1819年和1820年，他先后击败恩德万德韦军队，其中一战发生在姆赫拉图泽河。战败使兹维德的松散联盟瓦解。索尚加内、兹旺根达巴等领袖带领追随者向北迁移，将战争的影响带到远离旧居的地方。

english:
The Ndyuka are a Maroon people whose communities formed in the forests of Suriname from Africans who escaped enslavement on colonial plantations. They established villages along inland waterways and fought to defend their independence from Dutch forces. Their history is tied to the rivers and forest that sheltered communities beyond the plantation coast, in a country traversed by tributaries of the Maroni.

On 10 October 1760 Ndyuka leaders signed a peace treaty with the Dutch authorities. It recognised their autonomy while imposing obligations, including the return of other people escaping slavery. After the agreement, Dutch visitors were admitted to Ndyuka villages farther upstream. The treaty marked a significant change in relations between the colonial government and a community that had secured its freedom through resistance.
simp_chinese:
恩迪尤卡人是苏里南的马龙人群体，其社群由逃离殖民种植园奴役的非洲人在森林中建立。他们沿内陆水道建村，并与荷兰军队交战以保卫自主。河流与森林为种植园海岸之外的社群提供了庇护，马罗尼河支流穿过这片土地，也深刻影响了他们的历史。

1760年10月10日，恩迪尤卡首领与荷兰当局签订和平条约。条约承认其自治，也规定他们须承担交还其他逃亡奴隶等义务。协议达成后，荷兰访客得以进入更上游的恩迪尤卡村庄。条约标志着殖民政府与这一通过抵抗争得自由的社群之间关系的重大转变。

english: The Rocky Mountains rise around Lake Louise and the upper Bow River, with glaciers descending between steep peaks. Meltwater from the Victoria Glacier carries finely ground rock into the lake, giving its water a brilliant blue-green colour. Louise Creek carries the water onward to the Bow River. Farther north, Bow Lake and its glacier feed the river as it begins its journey eastward from the mountains.
simp_chinese: 落基山脉环绕路易丝湖与鲍河上游，冰川在陡峭山峰之间向下延伸。维多利亚冰川的融水将细碎岩粉带入湖中，使湖水呈现鲜明的蓝绿色。路易丝溪把湖水送入鲍河；更北面的鲍湖与冰川也为鲍河补给水源，河流由此开始向东流出山地。

english: Ne Miskua is a name for the Saline River of Kansas, recalling the salt carried in its waters. Rising on the High Plains, it runs eastward through the Smoky Hills to join the Smoky Hill River. Its branches cross open prairie and broad valleys, connecting the dry western grasslands with the river systems farther east. Salt springs and streams were valuable features of the central Plains landscape.
simp_chinese: 内米斯夸是堪萨斯萨林河的名称，与河水中的盐分有关。这条河发源于高平原，向东流经斯莫基丘陵，汇入斯莫基希尔河。其支流穿过开阔草原与宽阔河谷，将西部干燥草地与更东方的河流系统联系起来。盐泉和含盐水道是中央平原景观中有价值的资源。

english: Ne Shuta is a name recorded for the Arkansas River, which descends from the Rocky Mountains and crosses the central Plains on its long course toward the Mississippi. In western Kansas the river winds through a broad, often sandy valley, bordered by grasslands and tributary streams. Indigenous peoples used the river country for travel and seasonal hunting; farther east its waters joined a landscape of farming villages and wooded bottomlands.
simp_chinese: 内舒塔是阿肯色河的一个记载名称。这条河从落基山脉流下，横穿中央平原，长途流向密西西比河。在堪萨斯西部，河水蜿蜒穿过宽阔而多沙的河谷，两旁是草原及支流。原住民利用河流地区旅行和季节性狩猎；更东边的河岸则分布着农耕村落和林木覆盖的低地。

english: Neath stands on the River Neath in southern Wales, near the ruins of a once wealthy abbey. Founded in the twelfth century, Neath Abbey was dissolved in 1539, but its substantial buildings remained beside the river. In the late eighteenth century the surrounding valley acquired a different character as ironworks and copper smelting developed. The Neath Abbey ironworks, founded in 1792, stood beside the monastic ruins and produced machinery for a growing industry.
simp_chinese: 尼思坐落在威尔士南部尼思河畔，附近是一座曾经富有的修道院遗址。尼思修道院创立于十二世纪，1539年解散，但规模可观的建筑仍留在河边。十八世纪末，炼铁和炼铜业发展，周围河谷呈现不同面貌。1792年创办的尼思修道院铁厂位于修院废墟旁，为日益发展的工业制造机械。

english: Nebesek, “at the lake” in Abenaki, is the broad, shallow reach of the Saint Lawrence known as Lake Saint-Pierre. The Saint-François, Nicolet and Richelieu rivers enter from the south, while smaller rivers descend from the northern shore. Abenaki communities gathered along these waters; a mission on the Saint-François grew as families moved north during the wars in New England. The village was established at its later site in 1715, and became a centre of Abenaki life on the river.
simp_chinese: 内贝塞克在阿贝纳基语中意为“在湖边”，指圣劳伦斯河上一片宽阔而浅的水域，即圣皮埃尔湖。圣弗朗索瓦河、尼科莱河和黎塞留河从南岸汇入，北岸也有几条河流注入湖中。阿贝纳基社群在这些水道边聚集；新英格兰的战争促使一些家庭北迁，圣弗朗索瓦河畔的传教聚落随之扩大。1715年，村庄迁至后来长期所在的位置，成为河畔阿贝纳基人的生活中心。

english: The forests around Nebolchi belonged to the old Obonezhskaya lands of Novgorod. St George’s church district at Nebolchi was one of the rural pogosts listed in this region. In the woods nearby stood the Rekon Hermitage, whose documented history begins in the 1680s. It came under the Tikhvin Assumption monastery in 1685 and was suppressed in 1764. The hermitage later attracted renewed religious life, with the monk Amfilokhy settling in the district in 1812.
simp_chinese: 涅博尔奇周围的森林曾属于诺夫哥罗德古老的奥博涅日地区。涅博尔奇的圣乔治教堂辖区是当地记载中的乡村教堂村之一。附近林中还有列孔隐修院，其有文献可循的历史始于1680年代。1685年，隐修院归季赫温圣母安息修道院管理，1764年被裁撤。此后这里又重新兴起宗教生活，僧人安菲洛希于1812年来到这一地区。

english: Nebraska takes its name from an Omaha and Otoe expression for the Platte River, the broad, shallow stream crossing the central Plains. Its sandy channels and grassy banks ran through the country of the Pawnee, whose earth-lodge villages stood near the river and its tributaries. Families grew maize and other crops and traveled onto the plains for seasonal bison hunts. The river valley provided a passage between the Missouri and the western grasslands.
simp_chinese: 内布拉斯加之名来自奥马哈语和奥托语中对普拉特河的称呼。这条宽阔浅河穿过中央平原，其沙质河道和草岸位于波尼人地区，覆土房屋组成的村落分布在干流与支流附近。各家庭种植玉米等作物，也随季节前往平原猎取野牛。河谷构成密苏里河与西部草原之间的一条通道。

english: The Nechako flows through a broad interior country of lakes, forest and rivers before joining the Fraser. Its Dakelh name is associated with the people of the Blackwater River. Dakelh communities along the river and its tributaries fished for salmon and sturgeon, with particular fishing places belonging to families. Farther upstream, Cheslatta villages stood beside lakes linked by trails to other communities across the interior.
simp_chinese: 内查科河穿过湖泊、森林与河流交织的广阔内陆，最终汇入弗雷泽河。它的达凯尔语名称与布莱克沃特河的人们有关。沿河及支流生活的达凯尔社群捕捞鲑鱼和鲟鱼，特定渔场属于不同家族。更靠上游，切斯拉塔村落坐落在湖边，并有道路通往内陆其他社群。

english: Nechí stands where the river of that name meets the Cauca, in the low, wet country of northern Antioquia. The Nechí drains a gold-bearing basin before joining the larger river. By 1636 a hamlet known as San Antonio de Bermejal offered a resting place to travellers on these waterways. Routes from the port led towards Zaragoza and the mining districts, and towards Yarumal and the old provincial capital of Santa Fe de Antioquia.
simp_chinese: 内奇位于内奇河与考卡河交汇处，地处安蒂奥基亚北部低湿地带。内奇河流经含金的流域，最终汇入考卡河。到1636年，名为圣安东尼奥德贝梅哈尔的村落已为河上旅人提供歇脚之处。从港口出发的道路通往萨拉戈萨及矿区，也通往亚鲁马尔和当时的省府圣菲德安蒂奥基亚。

english:
Necoclí lies on the eastern shore of the Gulf of Urabá, where the Caribbean reaches deep into the mainland. Indigenous communities inhabited this coast before Spanish expeditions attempted to establish themselves at the gulf. Its beaches and waterways offered access to both sides of Urabá and to the Atrato basin. Ojeda named his fort for Saint Sebastian and built a small settlement of thatched huts beside it.

In 1509 Alonso de Ojeda established San Sebastián de Urabá near the later site of Necoclí. Indigenous resistance, disease and shortages weakened the settlement, which was abandoned in 1510. The survivors crossed the gulf to establish Santa María la Antigua del Darién. In 1535 Pedro de Heredia founded another settlement, San Sebastián de Buenavista, near Necoclí; it endured until around 1550.
simp_chinese:
内科克利位于乌拉瓦湾东岸，加勒比海在此深入大陆。西班牙远征队试图在海湾立足之前，沿岸已有原住民社群居住。海滩和水道可通往乌拉瓦湾两岸及阿特拉托河流域。奥赫达以圣塞瓦斯蒂安为堡垒命名，并在旁边建起茅屋聚落。

1509年，阿隆索·德·奥赫达在后来内科克利附近建立圣塞瓦斯蒂安德乌拉瓦。原住民抵抗、疾病和物资短缺削弱聚落，1510年它被放弃。幸存者横渡海湾，建立达连古圣玛利亚。1535年，佩德罗·德·埃雷迪亚在内科克利附近建立另一聚落圣塞瓦斯蒂安德布埃纳维斯塔，延续至约1550年。

english:
Necoes was a village of the Cape Fear Indians, about twenty miles from the mouth of the river of that name. Of five villages reported in 1715, it is the only one whose name was recorded. The people lived along the lower river, in a country of wetlands and forests close to the Atlantic coast.

In 1663 the English captain William Hilton met Watcoosa, described as a chief of the Cape Fear Indians, on an island in the river. The following year, after settlers seized Indigenous children and sent them away, the Indians drove the settlers out. As European settlement increased, the Cape Fear Indians sought protection from Governor John Archdale in 1695. Some later accompanied John Barnwell as scouts during the Tuscarora War of 1711–1712.
simp_chinese:
内科斯是开普菲尔印第安人的一个村庄，位于同名河流入海口约二十英里处。1715年的记录提到五个村庄，内科斯是其中唯一留下名称的一个。当地人居住在河流下游，靠近大西洋海岸，周围遍布湿地与森林。

1663年，英国船长威廉·希尔顿在河中一座岛上与沃特库萨会面；后者被记为开普菲尔印第安人的首领。次年，殖民者掳走原住民儿童并将他们送离当地，印第安人遂将殖民者驱逐。随着欧洲人不断迁入，开普菲尔印第安人于1695年向总督约翰·阿奇代尔请求保护。1711年至1712年的塔斯卡罗拉战争期间，一些人后来随约翰·巴恩韦尔充当侦察兵。

english: Neudong lies in the Yarlung country of central Tibet, close to the river valleys that nurtured the early Tibetan kingdom. Its fortress became the administrative seat of the Phagdru rulers, whose authority grew from the lands and monastic networks of the Phagmodrupa tradition. From here their government directed much of central Tibet. Between 1349 and 1354 Jangchub Gyaltsen broke the power of the Sakya administration and established Phagdru rule. He reorganised government around fortified districts and is credited with restoring a Tibetan legal system. Neudong remained the political centre of the dynasty even as its power later declined and the Rinpung family rose to dominance in the fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 乃东位于卫藏雅砻地区，靠近孕育吐蕃早期王国的河谷。乃东堡垒成为帕竹统治者的行政驻地，其权力源于帕木竹巴传承的土地和寺院网络，并由此治理卫藏广大地区。1349年至1354年间，绛曲坚赞打破萨迦政权的统治，建立帕竹政权。他以设有堡垒的宗为基础重组地方行政，并被认为恢复了藏式法律制度。即使后来帕竹势力衰落、仁蚌家族在十五世纪崛起，乃东仍是帕竹王朝的政治中心。

english: Nedroma lies in the mountains of western Algeria, between Tlemcen and the Mediterranean coast. Its Great Mosque is an example of Almoravid religious architecture, with a courtyard and prayer hall. A minaret was added in 1348, as recorded by an inscription. The town endured conflict among the powers of the Maghreb; the Marinid ruler Abu al-Hasan besieged it in 1335 during his campaign in the region.
simp_chinese: 奈德罗马位于阿尔及利亚西部山区，地处特莱姆森与地中海海岸之间。大清真寺是穆拉比特宗教建筑的例子，设有庭院和礼拜厅。铭文记载，宣礼塔于1348年增建。城镇曾经历马格里布各势力之间的冲突；1335年，马林王朝统治者阿布·哈桑在征战该地区时围攻此地。

english: Nee Tahi Buhn is a name associated with François Lake, a long inland lake whose eastern outlet leads towards the Nechako. Wet’suwet’en-speaking families used the lands around François and Uncha lakes through a seasonal round of fishing, hunting and gathering plants. Their social life was ordered through matrilineal clans and the balhats, or potlatch, where economic, judicial and spiritual matters were addressed. The waterways and trails joined this lake country to neighbouring communities.
simp_chinese: 尼塔希本是与弗朗索瓦湖相关的名称。这座狭长的内陆湖泊在东端流向内查科河。讲韦楚韦滕语的家庭随季节利用弗朗索瓦湖和安查湖周边的土地，捕鱼、狩猎并采集植物。母系氏族和称为巴尔哈茨的馈赠仪式组织社群生活，处理经济、司法与精神事务。水道和小径将湖区与邻近社群联系起来。

sources.title: A97944-4 Ecojustice Evidence - Documents - Part 1 - A6S0V9.pdf

english: Neebing lies near the western end of Lake Superior, among forest, rivers and the high ground above Thunder Bay. Nee-bing was a place of summer gatherings for the Ojibwe of this shore. Nearby, the Kaministiquia River provided a canoe route from the lake towards the inland waterways. French traders established posts near its mouth in the late seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries, and the North West Company later made Fort William a centre of its western trade.
simp_chinese: 尼宾位于苏必利尔湖西端附近，森林、河流与高地环绕着雷湾。尼宾是湖岸奥吉布瓦人夏季聚集的地方。附近的卡米尼斯蒂基亚河提供了从大湖通往内陆水道的独木舟路线。十七世纪末至十八世纪初，法国商人在河口附近建立贸易站；后来西北公司又以威廉堡为西部贸易中心。

english: Neekeari gives its name to the Nickerie country of western Suriname, where the river reaches the coastal lowlands near the Corantijn. Early European accounts recorded Indigenous peoples under similar names in this region. At the beginning of the seventeenth century the explorer Robert Harcourt reported Caribs on the Nickerie River; later accounts also mention Warao communities along the Nickerie and Maratakka. Rivers and wetlands formed the setting for these coastal societies.
simp_chinese: 尼凯亚里为苏里南西部的尼克里地区提供了名称。尼克里河在科兰太因河附近进入沿海低地。欧洲早期记载曾以相近名称称呼这一地区的原住民。十七世纪初，探险者罗伯特·哈考特记述尼克里河畔有加勒比人；后来的记载也提到瓦劳人居住在尼克里河与马拉塔卡河沿岸。河流和湿地构成这些沿海社会的生活环境。

english: Onamanii is the Ojibwe name associated with Lake Vermilion, a long lake of islands and bays in the northern forests. French fur traders called its waters Vermilion, translating a name linked to their reddish colour. Wild rice grew in shallow bays and along the Pike River, while fishing and hunting drew on the resources of the lake and surrounding woods. The Bois Forte Ojibwe lived in this country of interconnected lakes, rivers and dense forest.
simp_chinese: 奥纳马尼是与弗米利恩湖有关的奥吉布瓦语名称。这片狭长湖泊位于北方森林之中，岛屿和海湾众多。法国毛皮商人把与湖水红色有关的名称译为“朱红”。浅湾与派克河沿岸生长野米，居民也在湖泊及周围林地捕鱼、狩猎。布瓦福尔特奥吉布瓦人生活在这片湖河相连、森林茂密的土地上。

english: Neenowuxoote’i is an Arapaho name for Flatiron Mountain, meaning “they face to the north.” The mountain rises in the Colorado Front Range, above the valleys and plains to the east. Its rocky heights belong to a landscape of peaks, streams and passes named by Arapaho people who traveled through the region. The eastern slopes descend toward the Cache la Poudre and Big Thompson river country.
simp_chinese: 尼诺乌克索特是弗拉特艾恩山的阿拉帕霍语名称，意为“他们朝向北方”。山峰耸立在科罗拉多前岭，俯瞰东侧河谷和平原。岩石山岭属于一片由山峰、溪流与山口组成的景观，穿行于此的阿拉帕霍人为其中许多地点命名。东坡向卡什拉普德河与大汤普森河地区下降。

english: Neesihushaanu is a recorded name for the Knife River, which crosses the plains of western North Dakota to join the Missouri. Near its mouth stood the earthlodge villages of the Hidatsa, close to their Mandan neighbors on the Missouri. The river gave its name to this cluster of villages, a center of farming and trade whose connections extended across the northern Plains and beyond.
simp_chinese: 尼西胡沙努是奈夫河的一个记载名称。这条河穿过北达科他西部平原，汇入密苏里河。河口附近曾坐落着希达萨人的覆土屋村庄，与密苏里河畔的曼丹人村庄相邻。这组村落以河流命名，是农业与贸易的中心，其联系遍及北部平原及更远的地方。

english: Nefta is an oasis town north of Chott el Djerid in southwestern Tunisia. Its palm groves and gardens surround a settlement known for its religious buildings and the tombs of holy men. The Sufi saint Sidi Bou Ali, remembered for bringing Sunni Islam to the town in the thirteenth century, became an important figure of local devotion. Nefta’s oasis also lay on routes connecting the Tunisian Djerid with the Algerian Sahara.
simp_chinese: 内夫塔是突尼斯西南部杰里德盐沼以北的一座绿洲城镇。棕榈林和花园环绕着聚落，城中以宗教建筑和圣人墓地闻名。十三世纪的苏菲圣人西迪·布·阿里因被认为将逊尼派伊斯兰教带到此地而受到当地人崇敬。内夫塔绿洲也位于连接突尼斯杰里德与阿尔及利亚撒哈拉的道路上。

english: Negar lies in the high country of Bardsir, southwest of Kerman. A brick minaret remains from its old congregational mosque, built in the Seljuk period. Its patterned brickwork and turquoise Kufic inscription show the care lavished on a small town's religious architecture, while a spiral staircase rises inside the tower. Nearby stands a four-arched monument attributed to the Sasanian period, a reminder of an earlier chapter in the district's history.
simp_chinese: 内加尔位于克尔曼西南的巴尔德西尔高地。旧聚礼清真寺建于塞尔柱时期，其中一座砖砌宣礼塔仍然耸立。塔身的花纹砖饰和绿松石色库法体铭文，体现了小镇宗教建筑的精巧；塔内有螺旋阶梯向上盘旋。附近还有一座被认为属于萨珊时期的四拱建筑，见证当地更早的历史。

english:
Negombo stands beside a lagoon and river mouth on the western coast of Sri Lanka. The surrounding country produced cinnamon, a spice that attracted overseas merchants and made the harbour valuable to the powers seeking control of the coast. The Portuguese built a fort here by the end of the sixteenth century to guard access to the cinnamon districts and the revenues of the port.

The fort changed hands during the wars between Portugal and the Dutch East India Company. The Dutch seized it, lost it to the Portuguese, and captured it again in 1644. They repaired its walls and bastions in the following decades, keeping Negombo as a coastal stronghold. The British took the fort in 1796. Under the Dutch, experiments in cultivating cinnamon helped establish gardens in the western coastal region, and the valuable bark remained central to the island’s export trade.
simp_chinese:
尼甘布位于斯里兰卡西岸的潟湖与河口旁。周围地区出产肉桂，这种香料吸引海外商人，也使港湾成为争夺海岸控制权的势力所重视的地方。葡萄牙人在十六世纪末前修建堡垒，保护通往肉桂产区的道路和港口收入。

葡萄牙与荷兰东印度公司的战争期间，堡垒数次易手。荷兰人先夺取此堡，随后被葡萄牙人夺回，1644年又再次攻占。接下来数十年，荷兰人修缮城墙与棱堡，将尼甘布作为沿海据点。1796年英国人夺取堡垒。荷兰统治时期的肉桂栽培试验促进了西部海岸种植园的发展，这种珍贵树皮仍是岛屿出口贸易的核心。

english: Negoot belongs to the country of the Tobique River, a tributary of the Wolastoq in the homeland of the Wolastoqiyik. The river's Wolastoqey name, Neqotkuk, is associated with a word meaning to obstruct or block. At its mouth stood a fortified Wolastoqiyik village whose inhabitants were known as the people of Neqotkuk. They defended their home against Haudenosaunee raiding parties travelling down the Wolastoq, while the river and its branches led into the hunting grounds of the forested interior.
simp_chinese: 内古特属于托比克河地区。这条河是沃拉斯托克河的支流，流经沃拉斯托基伊克人的家园。托比克河的沃拉斯托基语名称内科特库克与“阻挡”或“阻塞”一词有关。河口曾有一座设防村庄，居民被称为内科特库克之民。他们抵御沿沃拉斯托克河而来的豪德诺索尼袭击者，河流及其支流则通向森林内陆的猎地。

english: Laguna Negra lies among the coastal wetlands of eastern Uruguay. Its dark appearance comes from fine peat particles, while surrounding marshes retain freshwater and support abundant plants and birds. It is also called Laguna de los Difuntos, a name linked to caves in nearby hills used by Indigenous people as burial places. Low sandy ground separates this broad lagoon from the Atlantic coast.
simp_chinese: 内格拉潟湖位于乌拉圭东部沿海湿地。细小泥炭颗粒使湖水呈深色，周围沼泽蓄积淡水，支持丰富的植物与鸟类。它也称“亡者潟湖”，名称与附近山中被原住民用作墓地的洞穴有关。低平沙地将宽广潟湖与大西洋海岸隔开。

english: Negra Point lies off the northeastern coast of Brazil near the Capibaribe River, where reefs, beaches and river mouths shape travel along the Pernambuco shore. Sugar estates and their mills spread through the coastal lowlands in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, linking Pernambuco's ports to Atlantic commerce through enslaved African labour. The Dutch occupation of Pernambuco in the 1630s and 1640s brought naval and military competition to these waters.
simp_chinese: 内格拉角位于巴西东北部卡皮巴里贝河附近的海岸外，礁石、沙滩和河口影响着伯南布哥海岸的航行。十六、十七世纪，制糖庄园与糖厂遍布沿海低地，借助被奴役的非洲劳工把伯南布哥的港口接入大西洋贸易。十七世纪三四十年代荷兰人占领伯南布哥，给这片海域带来海军与军事竞争。

english: Negril Point marks the western end of Jamaica, where the island’s coast turns between the Caribbean shores to north and south. Offshore, coral reefs and shallow waters fringe the island, while deeper passages open towards Cuba and Central America. Jamaica passed from Spanish to English control in 1655, and its bays and headlands became part of the maritime routes linking the colony to the wider Caribbean.
simp_chinese: 内格里尔角位于牙买加西端，岛屿海岸在此转向加勒比海的南北两侧。近海有珊瑚礁与浅水环绕，较深的水道则通向古巴和中美洲。牙买加于1655年从西班牙转归英国，其海湾与海角随后成为连接殖民地和加勒比各地的海上航路的一部分。

english:
This northern Amazon forest lies near the Casiquiare, the remarkable waterway that carries water from the Orinoco towards the Rio Negro. The Guramoni and Pasiba are short blackwater tributaries descending from the lowlands into the Casiquiare. Along its course, sandy banks alternate with narrower rocky stretches and rapids, while streams drain the forest on either side.

The later city of Puerto Ayacucho lies nearby.
simp_chinese:
这片亚马逊北部森林靠近卡西基亚雷河。卡西基亚雷河是一条奇特的水道，将奥里诺科河的水带向内格罗河。古拉莫尼河与帕西瓦河是从低地流入卡西基亚雷河的短小黑水支流。河岸的沙地与狭窄多石的河段、急流交替出现，两侧森林中还有溪流汇入。

后来的阿亚库乔港位于此地附近。

english: Chalkis stands at the narrowest point of the Euripus Strait, where a bridge joins Euboea to the Greek mainland. In antiquity it was a prosperous city whose settlers founded communities as far away as Italy and Sicily. Later, Byzantine writers called it Euripos, while western merchants knew the town and island as Negroponte. Venice seized the town in 1209, and it became a center shared by the republic and Euboea's Latin lords. Its position drew repeated attacks: the Catalan Company struck in 1317 and Turkish forces in 1350–51. After a long siege the Ottomans captured Negroponte in 1470, making it the seat of their admiral of the archipelago. A Venetian attempt to retake it in 1688 failed.
simp_chinese: 哈尔基斯位于欧里波斯海峡最狭窄处，桥梁在此连接埃维亚岛与希腊大陆。古代的哈尔基斯是一座繁荣城邦，移民远至意大利和西西里建立聚落。后来拜占庭作家称其为欧里波斯，西方商人则把这座城镇和岛屿称作内格罗蓬特。1209年威尼斯夺取城镇，此地成为共和国与埃维亚拉丁领主共同管辖的中心。其地位引来多次进攻：加泰罗尼亚佣兵团于1317年袭击此地，土耳其军队则在1350至1351年发动攻击。1470年，奥斯曼人在长期围城后攻陷内格罗蓬特，并将其作为群岛海军司令的驻地。1688年，威尼斯试图夺回城镇，却未能成功。

english: Neguac stands on the northern shore of Miramichi Bay, at the foot of the Acadian Peninsula. The coast and river valley were part of the country of the Mi'kmaq, and in the eighteenth century they became a refuge for Acadians driven from their homes. Jean Savoie and his family arrived at Neguac in 1757, two years after the deportations began. Other Acadian families later returned to settle along the shores of the bay.
simp_chinese: 内瓜克位于米拉米奇湾北岸，阿卡迪亚半岛南端。海岸与河谷属于米克马克人的土地；十八世纪，许多被逐出家园的阿卡迪亚人也来到这里避难。驱逐行动开始两年后，1757年让·萨瓦及其家人来到内瓜克。此后，其他阿卡迪亚家庭也陆续返回，在海湾沿岸定居。

english: Nehantuck is an old name associated with the Niantic River and the land beside its tidal waters. The Western Niantic lived in this part of southern New England, where the river opens toward Long Island Sound. Its name has been understood as a point of land on a tidal river. Colonial land records from the mid-seventeenth century refer to ground at the head of the Nehantuck, as English settlement spread into the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 内汉塔克是与尼安蒂克河及其潮汐水域旁土地相关的旧名。西尼安蒂克人居住在新英格兰南部的这一带，河流在此通向长岛海峡。这个名字被解释为潮汐河上的一处岬地。十七世纪中叶的殖民土地记录提及内汉塔克河源头附近的土地，当时英国聚落正向周围地区扩展。

english: Nehbandan lies in the dry country between southern Khorasan and Sistan. Its traditional windmills, built of earth and timber, use the strong winds that sweep across the region to turn millstones and grind grain. The vertical-axis mills are a distinctive feature of Sistan's settlements, where wind has long been both a force to be endured and a source of power for daily work.
simp_chinese: 内赫班丹位于南呼罗珊与锡斯坦之间的干旱地带。当地传统风磨以土和木材建造，利用横扫这一地区的强风带动磨石研磨谷物。这种竖轴风磨是锡斯坦聚落的鲜明特色：风既是居民长期需要承受的自然力量，也是日常劳作的动力来源。

english: Nehru is the country of the Nora, the largest tributary of the Selemdzha. Rising in the Dzhagdy Range, the river crosses the taiga and divides into channels when it reaches the plain. Its name has been connected with the Evenki word neru, meaning grayling, though other explanations have also been proposed. The Nora joins the Selemdzha from the right, sending its waters onward to the Zeya and the Amur.
simp_chinese: 讷鲁是诺拉河流经的地区。诺拉河发源于贾格德山脉，穿过针叶林，进入平原后分成数条水道，是谢列姆贾河最大的支流。河名被认为可能来自鄂温克语中表示茴鱼的“讷鲁”，也有其他解释。诺拉河从右岸注入谢列姆贾河，河水再经泽雅河汇入黑龙江。

english: The dry plateaus of northern Santa Cruz form part of the country of the Aonikenk and other peoples of Patagonia. Guanacos ranged across the steppe and were a central resource for Indigenous hunters, supplying meat as well as hides. The region’s rivers and sheltered places offered contrast to the open, windswept uplands. Nehuen Mulfuñ is a Mapuche-Tehuelche community name associated with this area.
simp_chinese: 圣克鲁斯北部的干燥高原属于奥尼肯克人及其他巴塔哥尼亚人的地域。原驼出没于草原，为原住民猎手提供重要资源，既供肉食，也供皮革。当地河流和受庇护的地点与风吹过的开阔高地形成对照。内韦恩穆尔富尼是与这一带相关的马普切—特维尔切社群名称。

english: Nei lies between the Toyama plain and the mountains of Etchū. The market town of Yatsuo grew near the foothills, exchanging goods from the mountains and the surrounding countryside. It received permission to establish a town from the Kaga domain in 1636. Merchants prospered through the production and sale of silkworm eggs, and later paper wholesalers supplied bags for the medicines sold by traveling merchants of Etchū.
simp_chinese: 妇负位于越中富山平原与山地之间。山麓的八尾发展成市镇，交换山中与周边乡村的物产。1636年，加贺藩批准在此建町。当地商人靠生产和销售蚕种积累财富，后来纸张批发商又为越中行商所售药物供应药袋。

english:
The Neiba Mountains rise in southwestern Hispaniola, north of Lake Enriquillo. Precolonial archaeological sites in the range include Las Caritas near the lake. According to Neiba's municipal history, the nearby district belonged to the Indigenous chiefdom of Jaragua before Spanish conquest.

Spanish conquest brought violence, forced labour and disease to Indigenous societies across Hispaniola. In the wider southwest, people escaping enslavement established communities in difficult terrain. The maniel of Neiba was located in the separate Bahoruco range to the south; colonial authorities organized an expedition against it in 1768. Its history illustrates resistance in the region without placing that community in the Neiba Mountains themselves.
simp_chinese:
内巴山脉位于伊斯帕尼奥拉西南部、恩里基约湖北方。山中有殖民前考古遗址，包括湖附近的拉斯卡里塔斯。内巴市地方历史记载，西班牙征服以前，邻近地区属于原住民哈拉瓜酋邦。

西班牙征服使岛上的原住民社会遭受暴力、强迫劳动和疾病。在更广阔的西南地区，逃离奴役的人们在险峻地带建立社群。内巴的马涅尔位于南方另一条山脉巴奥鲁科，殖民当局于1768年组织远征攻打它。这段历史展示了区域内的反抗，但不能将该社群误置于内巴山脉。

english:
Neihuang lies on the northern Henan plain. Its county name dates back to the Han period, and the county seat moved during its long history. In the Song it belonged to Daming prefecture; under the Jin and Yuan it was associated with Hua prefecture. The county returned to Daming prefecture in the early Ming.

The Qing initially followed the Ming administrative arrangement, but Neihuang was later transferred to Zhangde prefecture in Henan. County gazetteers recorded these changes of jurisdiction as well as the old course of the Yellow River east of the county, a reminder of the changing waterways of the plain.
simp_chinese:
内黄位于河南北部平原，县名可追溯至汉代，县治在漫长历史中曾经迁移。宋代它属于大名府，金元时期隶属滑州；明初又改属大名府。

清初沿袭明代建制，后来内黄由大名改属河南彰德府。地方县志记录了这些行政变化，也提及县东的黄河故道，反映出平原水系历经的变迁。

english: Neijiang stands beside the Tuo River in the southern Sichuan Basin. Its warm valleys have long supported sugar cane, grown here by at least the Song period. In 1716 a migrant from Fujian, Zeng Dayi, introduced another variety of cane and established a sugar workshop. Others followed, planting the crop along the river and expanding the making of sugar, a craft that became closely associated with the town.
simp_chinese: 内江位于四川盆地南部的沱江边。温暖的河谷适合种植甘蔗，至少宋代已有蔗田。1716年，福建移民曾达一引入新的甘蔗品种，在当地开办糖坊。乡邻纷纷效仿，沿江种植甘蔗、制作蔗糖，糖业逐渐成为这座城镇的重要特色。

english: Neiqiu lies at the eastern foot of the Taihang Mountains. At the foot of Que Mountain stands a temple to Bian Que, the celebrated physician honoured here as a healing god. Pilgrims came to worship among its halls, bridges, and ancient trees, and stone inscriptions record generations of patronage. The temple was rebuilt in 1268 under the Yuan and again in 1487 under the Ming. A bridge before the shrine, traditionally associated with the physician's power to restore life, was rebuilt in the sixteenth century. Its name of Nine Dragons recalled the nine mountain streams that converge after rain.
simp_chinese: 内丘位于太行山东麓。鹊山脚下的扁鹊庙供奉被尊为医神的名医扁鹊，香客来到殿宇、石桥和古树之间祭拜，历代碑刻记载了人们对庙宇的捐建。 庙宇在元代1268年和明代1487年重建。庙前石桥传统上与扁鹊起死回生的医术有关，十六世纪重修后称九龙桥，因山中九条溪涧雨后汇流而得名。

english: Neixiang lies in the Nanyang basin, where roads from the mountains reach the fertile plain. Its county office was established in 1304 under the Yuan, providing halls and accommodation for the magistrate and his staff. Rebuilt and enlarged in the early Ming, it remained the centre of local administration through successive dynasties. Its courts and offices made the county seat a place where law and government were exercised daily.
simp_chinese: 内乡位于南阳盆地，山间道路在此通向肥沃平原。元大德八年（1304年），县官始建衙署厅堂与官舍；明初又加以重建扩充。历经朝代更替，县衙始终是地方行政中心，官员在堂前处理诉讼与政务。

english: Nejanilini Lake lies in the far northern lake country west of Hudson Bay. Around it, open forest gives way to lichen woodland and forest-tundra, with bogs among the lakes. The Sayisi Dene know the lake as Bah yon and have long travelled and hunted across this northern country. The land around its waters forms part of the great range of the caribou, an animal central to the lives of the Dene of the interior.
simp_chinese: 内贾尼利尼湖位于哈德孙湾以西的遥远北方湖区。湖泊周围的疏林逐渐过渡为地衣林地和森林苔原，泥沼分布在众湖之间。萨伊西德内人称此湖为Bah yon，长期在这片北方土地上旅行和狩猎。湖区也是驯鹿广阔活动范围的一部分；对内陆德内人的生活而言，驯鹿具有重要地位。

english: Nekemte lies in the wooded highlands of Wellega, in western Ethiopia. The growth of settlements in this region followed the establishment of Oromo farming communities from the late sixteenth century. Their social life included the gadaa system, under which leadership passed to a new age class at intervals of eight years. Nearby Lieka and Bilo were important markets before Nekemte itself rose to prominence.
simp_chinese: 内格姆特位于埃塞俄比亚西部沃莱加的林木高地。自十六世纪末奥罗莫农耕社群在此定居后，地区聚落逐渐成长。当地社会生活包括加达制度，领导权每隔八年交给新的年龄阶层。在内格姆特兴起之前，附近的列卡和比洛已是重要市场。

english: Nekhel lies in the arid interior of Sinai on the route followed by the pilgrimage caravan from Egypt to Mecca. Its fort guarded a stopping place in a landscape where reliable water was precious. The Mamluk sultan Qansuh al-Ghuri ordered the fortress built in the early sixteenth century, shortly before the Ottoman conquest of Egypt. Its garrison helped secure the passage of pilgrims and traders across the peninsula.
simp_chinese: 奈赫勒位于西奈干旱的内陆，处在埃及通往麦加的朝觐商队道路上。这里的堡垒守卫着一处歇脚站，在可靠水源珍贵的地方尤为重要。十六世纪初，马穆鲁克苏丹甘苏·高里下令修建堡垒，不久后奥斯曼人征服了埃及。驻军帮助保障朝圣者和商人穿越半岛的道路。

english: Nekloch belongs to the lake country at the headwaters of the Polota, a tributary of the Western Dvina. Its name appears in accounts of an expedition into the lands of Polotsk in the twelfth century. Lakes and wooded ground mark this northern edge of the old Polotsk region, where waterways lead south towards the Dvina and its settlements. The lake of Nekloch preserves the name of the locality in this landscape.
simp_chinese: 涅克洛奇位于波洛塔河源头的湖泊地带；波洛塔河是西德维纳河的支流。12世纪一次进军波洛茨克地区的记载中就出现了这个地名。湖泊与林地构成古波洛茨克地区北缘的景观，水路向南通往西德维纳河及其沿岸聚落。涅克洛奇湖则在这片土地上保留了这一名称。

sources.title: Hieorhij Stychau.Horoda Polockoj ziemli IX XIII vv. .pdf

english:
Nicoya was an important Indigenous center on the peninsula between the Pacific Ocean and the gulf that bears its name. Its inhabitants belonged to a region with close cultural ties to Mesoamerica; Spanish observers described a complex society with specialized groups. The settlement gave its name to a wider district whose history developed separately from that of the Central Valley.

Gil González Dávila reached Nicoya during his expedition along the Pacific coast in 1523.
