Roads and mills followed as more families arrived during the 1820s, including immigrants from Britain and families who had come from Pennsylvania after the American Revolution.
simp_chinese: 尼苏里位于五大湖内陆，是一片溪流与森林交错的土地。地名被认为与一个意为“流动的水”的原住民词汇有关，与穿过这里的众多水道相称。乡区约于1820年完成测量，早期移民到1822年已召开乡镇会议。更多家庭在1820年代迁入，道路和磨坊随之出现；新居民包括英国移民，也有美国革命后从宾夕法尼亚迁来的家庭。

english: Nistam, meaning “the first lake” in Cree, lies in the forested country east of James Bay. The nearby Rupert River winds through lakes and rapids on its way west to the bay, where it reaches Waskaganish. In the seventeenth century a trading post was established at the river mouth, drawing Cree hunters and traders into new exchanges while the waterways continued to connect the coast with the interior.
simp_chinese: 尼斯塔姆在克里语中意为“第一座湖”，位于詹姆斯湾以东的森林地带。附近的鲁珀特河穿过湖泊和急流，向西流往瓦斯卡加尼什，注入海湾。十七世纪，河口建立了贸易站，克里猎人和商人与外来者展开新的交换；水道则继续将海岸与广阔的内陆相连接。

english: Nita lies among the wooded mountains of inland Izumo, a district long associated with tatara ironmaking. Its furnaces used iron sand and charcoal to produce iron and steel, drawing on materials found in the surrounding country. By 1726, records describe a tatara operation at Nita; the craft and its demand for fuel tied the work of the furnace to the forests and streams of the mountain villages.
simp_chinese: 仁多位于出云内陆的林木山地，长期以踏鞴炼铁闻名。炉匠利用当地的砂铁和木炭炼制铁与钢，山林中的资源因此被送入炉中。到1726年，文献已记载仁多的踏鞴作业；炼炉的技艺和燃料需求，将工场与山村周围的森林、溪流联系在一起。

english: Nita' is an old watering place and village in Wadi al-Miyah, the long depression east of the al-Suman plateau. Its well was known for abundant fresh water, and the place appears in early Arabic geographical writing and poetry. Palm cultivation grew around the water, while the neighbouring lowlands included the salt flat of Nita'. In this dry part of eastern Arabia, the well served both people and their animals.
simp_chinese: 尼塔是苏曼高原以东米亚谷中的古老水源地和村落。这里的井以淡水充沛著称，早期阿拉伯地理著作和诗歌中便提到此地。水源周围种植棕榈，邻近低地还有尼塔盐沼。在阿拉伯东部这片干旱地区，水井为人和牲畜提供饮水。

english: Nit’ahéndé is a name associated with a Mescalero Apache group of the mountains of southern New Mexico. The group ranged along the Rio Bonito and Rio Hondo and through the Capitan and Sacramento mountains. These ranges and their valleys formed part of a wider Apache homeland between the Rio Grande and the Pecos, where families moved to hunt and gather the foods of different elevations.
simp_chinese: 尼塔亨德是与新墨西哥南部山区一支梅斯卡莱罗阿帕奇群体相关的名称。该群体活动于博尼托河、翁多河沿岸以及卡皮坦山和萨克拉门托山一带。这些山脉与山谷属于格兰德河和佩科斯河之间更广阔的阿帕奇故土，家庭随不同海拔的食物资源移动，狩猎并采集。

english: Nitamibontegw is an Abenaki name for the first falls on Otter Creek, upstream from its mouth on Lake Champlain. The river was a route through the valley for Indigenous communities, linking the lake with the interior. A sawmill was built at the falls in 1764, and the settlement that grew there became Vergennes. During the War of 1812, American forces assembled a fleet at the falls for the battle fought on Lake Champlain in 1814.
simp_chinese: 尼塔米邦特格是阿贝纳基人对水獭溪第一处瀑布的称呼，瀑布位于河流注入尚普兰湖的河口上游。原住民社群利用这条河穿行于河谷，连接湖区与内陆。1764年，瀑布旁建起一座锯木厂，后来发展的聚落成为韦尔热讷。1812年战争期间，美军在瀑布附近集结舰队，参加了1814年的尚普兰湖战斗。

english: Nito was a Maya trading settlement near the mouth of the Río Dulce, where the waters of Lake Izabal reach the Caribbean. Merchants from several regions gathered there, bringing goods along the coastal and inland waterways. A Spanish raid around 1524 seized the town and its merchandise, causing the traders to flee. Hernán Cortés reached the area in 1525 during his difficult journey to Honduras and found the once-busy port disrupted by the intrusion.
simp_chinese: 尼托是杜尔塞河口附近的一处玛雅贸易聚落，伊萨瓦尔湖的水由此流向加勒比海。来自多个地区的商人在此聚集，沿海岸和内陆水道运送货物。约1524年，西班牙人袭击城镇，夺取商品，迫使商人逃离。1525年，埃尔南·科尔特斯艰难跋涉前往洪都拉斯时抵达此地，发现这座曾经繁忙的港口已被入侵打乱。

english:
Nitra rises above the river of the same name, its castle hill holding the cathedral and residence of the bishop. A centre of early Slavic power and later an episcopal seat in the Kingdom of Hungary, it grew into a town beneath the fortified height. King Béla IV granted its inhabitants privileges in 1248 after the castle had resisted the Mongol invasion.

The town and castle suffered during the struggles of the late Middle Ages, including a Hussite siege in 1432. Ottoman raids began in the sixteenth century, prompting further strengthening of the defences. In 1663 the Ottomans captured both town and castle and damaged the cathedral, but imperial forces recovered the stronghold the following year. Bishop Tomáš Pálffy then had its defences rebuilt. The castle was fought over again during the uprising of Francis II Rákóczi; after the war, Bishop Ladislav Adam Erdődy reconstructed the church and built a new episcopal palace.
simp_chinese:
尼特拉坐落在同名河流之畔，城堡山上有主教座堂和主教居所。这里曾是早期斯拉夫势力的中心，后来成为匈牙利王国的主教驻地，城镇在设防的高地下方发展起来。1248年，贝拉四世国王在城堡抵御蒙古入侵后，向居民授予特权。

中世纪晚期的战乱使城镇和城堡受损，1432年的胡斯派围攻便是其中之一。十六世纪，奥斯曼军队开始袭扰此地，促使守方继续加固城防。1663年，奥斯曼军队占领城镇与城堡，主教座堂遭到破坏；次年帝国军收复要塞。主教托马什·帕尔菲随后重建防御工事。弗朗茨二世·拉科齐起义期间，城堡再次成为争夺目标；战后，主教拉迪斯拉夫·亚当·厄尔德迪重建教堂，兴建新的主教宫。

english: The Nitrian Desert stretches west of Egypt's Nile Delta, a land of sand, stone and salt-bearing depressions. In late antiquity its solitude drew Christian hermits seeking lives of prayer. Monastic communities grew at Nitria, Kellia and Scetis, the last in Wadi El Natrun. Although Nitria and Kellia were eventually abandoned, Scetis remained inhabited through the Middle Ages, preserving a tradition that began with the desert fathers of the fourth century.
simp_chinese: 尼特里亚沙漠延伸在埃及尼罗河三角洲以西，遍布沙石和含盐洼地。古代晚期，这片幽寂之地吸引了寻求祈祷生活的基督教隐修者。尼特里亚、凯利亚和斯凯提斯相继形成修道群体，其中斯凯提斯位于奈特伦谷。尽管尼特里亚和凯利亚最终被废弃，斯凯提斯在中世纪仍有人居住，延续了四世纪沙漠教父开创的传统。

english: Nitta lies in the eastern plain of Kōzuke, where the Nitta family developed a large estate in the twelfth century. Its descendants became prominent warriors of the eastern provinces. In 1333 Nitta Yoshisada raised his banner at Ikushina Shrine and marched against the Kamakura shogunate. His campaign ended with the fall of Kamakura and the Hōjō regency, carrying the name of this provincial estate into the politics of the whole country.
simp_chinese: 新田位于上野东部平原。十二世纪，新田氏在此开发广阔庄园，其后裔成为东国重要武家。1333年，新田义贞在生品神社举兵，进攻镰仓幕府。镰仓和北条执权政权随之覆灭，使这处地方庄园的名字与全国政局联系在一起。

english: South of Tonga’s northern Niuas, the Pacific connects Niuatoputapu and Niuafoʻou with the islands farther south. Dutch navigators Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire reached the northern islands in 1616, encountering communities that already maintained relationships across the Tongan archipelago.
simp_chinese: 汤加北部纽阿群岛以南，太平洋连接纽阿托普塔普、纽阿福欧和更南方的岛屿。1616年，荷兰航海家威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔抵达北部岛屿，遇见早已在汤加群岛间维持联系的社群。

english: Southeast of Niuatoputapu, the open Pacific Ocean separates the northern Tongan islands from Niue. Dutch navigators Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire encountered Niuatoputapu in 1616, while its Polynesian inhabitants already belonged to a wider world of island voyaging and chiefly relationships.
simp_chinese: 纽阿托普塔普东南方的开阔大洋将汤加北部岛屿与纽埃隔开。1616年，荷兰航海家威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔来到纽阿托普塔普，当地波利尼西亚居民早已参与更广阔的岛际航行与酋长关系网络。

english: North of Niuafoʻou, the Pacific lies between Tonga’s northern islands and Samoa. Polynesian communities inhabited these islands long before European arrival. In 1616 Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire sailed through the Niuas, encountering Niuafoʻou and Niuatoputapu on their westward voyage.
simp_chinese: 纽阿福欧以北的太平洋位于汤加北部岛屿与萨摩亚之间。早在欧洲人到来之前，波利尼西亚社群已在这些岛屿生活。1616年，威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔向西航行经过纽阿群岛，遇见了纽阿福欧和纽阿托普塔普。

english: East of Niuatoputapu, open waters extend between Tonga and Samoa. In 1616 the Dutch expedition of Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire encountered the northern Tongan islands. The voyagers met islanders whose communities were linked by canoe travel across this part of the Pacific.
simp_chinese: 纽阿托普塔普以东的开阔水域延伸在汤加与萨摩亚之间。1616年，威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔的荷兰船队遇见汤加北部岛屿。航海者见到了岛民，他们的社群通过独木舟航行联系在一起。

english: Niuafoʻou is a volcanic island in northern Tonga, its high rim surrounding a crater lake. Steep shores and reefs make landing difficult. In 1616 the Dutch voyagers Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire passed the northern Tongan islands, meeting people whose canoes carried them across the sea between island communities.
simp_chinese: 纽阿福欧是汤加北部的火山岛，高耸的火山口边缘围绕着湖泊。陡岸与礁盘使登岸并不容易。1616年，荷兰航行者威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔经过汤加北部岛屿，遇到乘独木舟在岛屿社群之间航行的人们。

english: Niuafoʻou is a volcanic island in northern Tonga, its steep coast rising above the Pacific. Polynesian communities lived here long before the arrival of Dutch navigators Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire in 1616. Their expedition named the island Good Hope during a westward voyage across the ocean.
simp_chinese: 纽阿福欧是汤加北部的一座火山岛，陡峭海岸从太平洋上升起。早在荷兰航海家威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔于1616年抵达之前，波利尼西亚社群已在岛上生活。他们横渡大洋向西航行时，将该岛命名为好望岛。

english: Niuatoputapu is a volcanic island in northern Tonga, close to the steep island of Tafahi. In 1616 Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire encountered its people during a Dutch voyage across the Pacific. Trading gave way to conflict as armed islanders approached in canoes and the visitors fired their weapons before sailing westward.
simp_chinese: 纽阿托普塔普是汤加北部的一座火山岛，邻近陡峭的塔法希岛。1616年，威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔在荷兰横渡太平洋的航行中遇到岛民。双方先有交易，随后发生冲突：武装岛民乘独木舟靠近，访客开火后向西驶离。

english: Niuatoputapu lies in northern Tonga, near the steep volcanic island of Tafahi in the Pacific. In 1616 the Dutch expedition of Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire encountered its inhabitants. Violence broke out during the meeting, and the Dutch named Niuatoputapu Traitors’ Island.
simp_chinese: 纽阿托普塔普位于汤加北部，靠近陡峭的塔法希火山岛。1616年，威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔的荷兰船队遇见当地居民。双方相遇期间发生暴力冲突，荷兰人将纽阿托普塔普命名为“叛徒岛”。

english:
Niue is a raised coral island in the South Pacific, with steep coastal cliffs and a broad limestone plateau rising above the surrounding coral reef. Its Polynesian people preserve traditions of voyaging and links with Samoa and Tonga. Their language reflects these connections across the ocean; unlike an atoll, the island has no sheltered central lagoon.

In 1774 James Cook approached Niue on his second voyage across the Pacific Ocean. His attempts to land met determined resistance from islanders, and he sailed away after he named it Savage Island. In 1830 the missionary John Williams also visited, but a lasting mission was not established during his visit. The islanders’ reception of outsiders reflected the importance of defending their shores and their autonomy.

The later city of Alofi lies here.
simp_chinese:
纽埃是南太平洋一座隆起的珊瑚岛，陡峭海崖与宽阔石灰岩高原耸立于周围珊瑚礁之上。当地波利尼西亚人保存着航行传统和与萨摩亚、汤加的联系，其语言反映了这些跨海联系；它不像环礁那样有受庇护的中央潟湖。

1774年，詹姆斯·库克在第二次横越太平洋的航行中驶近纽埃。他试图登岸时遇到岛民坚决抵抗，于是将其称为野蛮岛后驶离。1830年，传教士约翰·威廉斯也曾到访，但未在此建立持久的传教站。岛民对外来者的回应反映出守护海岸与自主地位的重要性。

后来的阿洛菲即位于此地。

english: Niue rises from the Pacific as a high coral island, its coast edged by cliffs and reef. Polynesian communities inhabited it before James Cook arrived in 1774. His attempts to approach the shore met resistance from islanders, and he gave Niue the name Savage Island.
simp_chinese: 纽埃是一座从太平洋中升起的高珊瑚岛，海岸边缘有崖壁和珊瑚礁。詹姆斯·库克于1774年到来之前，波利尼西亚社群已在岛上生活。他试图靠近海岸时遭到岛民抵抗，便将纽埃命名为“野人岛”。

english: North of Niue, open ocean lies between the raised coral island and the Samoan archipelago. Niue was inhabited by Polynesian communities before James Cook visited in 1774. His attempts to come ashore met resistance, leading him to give the island the name Savage Island.
simp_chinese: 纽埃以北的开阔大洋位于这座隆起的珊瑚岛与萨摩亚群岛之间。詹姆斯·库克于1774年到访之前，波利尼西亚社群已在纽埃生活。他试图上岸时遭到抵抗，因此将岛屿命名为“野人岛”。

english: Northeast of Niue, the open Pacific extends away from the island’s steep coral coast. The island was already inhabited when James Cook arrived in 1774. His landing attempts encountered resistance from Niueans, and he left with a name for the island that reflected this brief encounter.
simp_chinese: 纽埃东北方的开阔太平洋从岛屿陡峭的珊瑚海岸向外延伸。詹姆斯·库克于1774年到来时岛上已有居民。他的登陆尝试遭到纽埃人抵抗，离开时给岛屿起了一个反映这次短暂接触的名字。
